source.text: בִּשְׁנַת֙ שְׁתֵּ֣ים עֶשְׂרֵ֔ה לְאָחָ֖ז מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה מָ֠לַךְ הוֹשֵׁ֨עַ בֶּן־אֵלָ֧ה בְשֹׁמְר֛וֹן עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל תֵּ֥שַׁע שָׁנִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: In year two ten of Ahaz king of Judah reigned Hoshea son of Elah in Samaria over Israel nine years.

en.L: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah, Hoshea son of Elah reigned in Samaria over Israel, nine years.
en.B: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah, Hoshea son of Elah became king over Israel in Samaria, and he reigned nine years.
en.R: Hoshea son of Elah became king over Israel in the twelfth year that Ahaz was king of Judah. Hoshea ruled in Samaria for nine years.

es.L: En el año doce de Acaz, rey de Judá, reinó Oseas hijo de Ela en Samaria sobre Israel nueve años.
es.B: En el año doce de Acaz, rey de Judá, Oseas hijo de Ela comenzó a reinar sobre Israel en Samaria, y reinó nueve años.
es.R: Oseas hijo de Ela comenzó a reinar sobre Israel en el año doce del reinado de Acaz en Judá. Oseas gobernó en Samaria durante nueve años.

fr.L: En la douzième année d’Achaz, roi de Juda, Osée fils d’Éla régna à Samarie sur Israël neuf ans.
fr.B: La douzième année du règne d’Achaz, roi de Juda, Osée, fils d’Éla, devint roi d’Israël à Samarie ; il régna neuf ans.
fr.R: Osée fils d’Éla est devenu roi d’Israël la douzième année du règne d’Achaz, roi de Juda. Osée a régné à Samarie pendant neuf ans.

sw.L: Katika mwaka wa kumi na mbili wa Ahazi mfalme wa Yuda, Hoshea mwana wa Ela alitawala huko Samaria juu ya Israeli miaka tisa.
sw.B: Katika mwaka wa kumi na mbili wa Ahazi mfalme wa Yuda, Hoshea mwana wa Ela alianza kutawala juu ya Israeli huko Samaria, akatawala miaka tisa.
sw.R: Hoshea mwana wa Ela alianza kutawala juu ya Israeli katika mwaka wa kumi na mbili wa utawala wa Ahazi mfalme wa Yuda. Hoshea alitawala akiwa Samaria kwa miaka tisa.

vi.L: Năm thứ mười hai đời A-cha vua Giu-đa, Ô-sê con trai Ê-la trị vì tại Sa-ma-ri trên Y-sơ-ra-ên chín năm.
vi.B: Năm thứ mười hai đời A-cha vua Giu-đa, Ô-sê con trai Ê-la lên làm vua Y-sơ-ra-ên tại Sa-ma-ri và trị vì chín năm.
vi.R: Ô-sê con trai Ê-la lên làm vua Y-sơ-ra-ên vào năm thứ mười hai đời A-cha làm vua Giu-đa. Ô-sê cai trị tại Sa-ma-ri chín năm.

ko.L: 유다 왕 아하스의 제십이년에 엘라의 아들 호세아가 사마리아에서 이스라엘을 구 년 동안 다스렸다.
ko.B: 유다 왕 아하스가 다스린 지 십이 년째 되는 해에 엘라의 아들 호세아가 사마리아에서 이스라엘의 왕이 되어 구 년 동안 다스렸다.
ko.R: 유다 왕 아하스가 다스린 지 십이 년째 되는 해에 엘라의 아들 호세아가 이스라엘의 왕이 되었다. 호세아는 사마리아에서 구 년 동안 다스렸다.

pt.L: No décimo segundo ano de Acaz, rei de Judá, Oseias, filho de Elá, reinou em Samaria sobre Israel, nove anos.
pt.B: No décimo segundo ano de Acaz, rei de Judá, Oseias, filho de Elá, começou a reinar sobre Israel em Samaria, e reinou nove anos.
pt.R: Oseias, filho de Elá, se tornou rei de Israel no décimo segundo ano em que Acaz era rei de Judá. Oseias governou em Samaria durante nove anos.

decisions.choice: Hoshea son of Elah: the last king of Israel
decisions.reason: Hoshea took the throne by killing Pekah (15:30). His nine years end with the fall of Samaria and the end of the northern kingdom (verse 6).

decisions.choice: the twelfth year of Ahaz: one of several ways of counting the reigns
decisions.reason: 15:30 dates Hoshea's coup to the twentieth year of Jotham, Ahaz's father. The two dates do not fit together simply. Reigns in Kings sometimes overlapped, as when a son ruled beside his father, and were counted in more than one way, so the figures cannot always be lined up without remainder.

decisions.choice: reigned (Literal); became king ... and he reigned (Balanced); became king ... ruled (Readable)
decisions.reason: The accession formula has one wording at each level throughout Kings (1 Kings 16:8). Literal follows the Hebrew; Readable splits it into two sentences.

decisions.choice: Oseias, filho de Elá
decisions.reason: The last king of Israel (m1) is "Oseias, filho de Elá", as the chapters before name him (15:30); "Oseias" is written without the accent the 1990 spelling dropped, and "Elá" keeps the accent 1 Kings 16:8 gives the name. The synchronism keeps the wording 1 Kings 16:8 set at each level.

source.text: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה רַ֗ק לֹ֚א כְּמַלְכֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָי֖וּ לְפָנָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And he did the evil in [the] eyes of Yahweh, only not like [the] kings of Israel who were before him.

en.L: And he did the evil in [the] eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, only not like the kings of Israel who were before him.
en.B: He did what was evil in the sight of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, yet not as the kings of Israel before him had done.
en.R: He did what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said was evil, but he was not as bad as the kings of Israel before him.

es.L: E hizo lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, aunque no como los reyes de Israel que fueron antes de él.
es.B: Hizo lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, aunque no como los reyes de Israel que lo precedieron.
es.R: Hizo lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} reprueba, pero no fue tan malo como los reyes de Israel que reinaron antes que él.

fr.L: Et il fit ce qui est mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, seulement pas comme les rois d’Israël qui furent avant lui.
fr.B: Il fit ce qui est mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, mais pas autant que les rois d’Israël qui l’avaient précédé.
fr.R: Il a fait ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} déclare mauvais, mais il n’a pas été aussi mauvais que les rois d’Israël avant lui.

sw.L: Naye akafanya maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ila si kama wafalme wa Israeli waliokuwa kabla yake.
sw.B: Alifanya maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, lakini si kama wafalme wa Israeli waliomtangulia walivyofanya.
sw.R: Alifanya yale {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyoyaona kuwa mabaya, lakini hakuwa mbaya kama wafalme wa Israeli waliomtangulia.

vi.L: Ông làm điều ác trước mắt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, chỉ không như các vua Y-sơ-ra-ên trước ông.
vi.B: Ông làm điều ác trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, nhưng không như các vua Y-sơ-ra-ên trước ông.
vi.R: Ông làm điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho là ác, nhưng ông không tệ bằng các vua Y-sơ-ra-ên trước ông.

ko.L: 그리고 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 눈에 악한 일을 했으나, 그보다 먼저 있었던 이스라엘 왕들과 같지는 않았다.
ko.B: 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 보시기에 악한 일을 했으나, 그보다 앞선 이스라엘 왕들만큼은 아니었다.
ko.R: 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 악하다고 하신 일을 했다. 그러나 그보다 앞선 이스라엘 왕들만큼 나쁘지는 않았다.

pt.L: E fez o mal aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, porém não como os reis de Israel que foram antes dele.
pt.B: Ele fez o que era mau aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, mas não como os reis de Israel que vieram antes dele.
pt.R: Ele fez o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} considerava mau, mas não foi tão mau quanto os reis de Israel antes dele.

decisions.choice: only not like the kings before him: a lighter verdict, not explained
decisions.reason: Hoshea receives the evil verdict, but with a limit. Unlike nearly every king of Israel, he is not said to walk in the sin of Jeroboam. The writer does not say why. Hosea 10:5-6 speaks of the calf of Bethel being carried off to Assyria, and some think the calf worship had already been weakened; this cannot be shown from Kings.

decisions.choice: did the evil in the eyes of Yahweh: the verdict formula
decisions.reason: The standing verdict on a king in Kings (1 Kings 15:26, 34). Even the least bad of Israel's kings is judged by it, and the end of the kingdom comes in his reign: the fall is the result of the whole history the writer will now explain (verses 7-23).

decisions.choice: did the evil in [the] eyes of / did what was evil in the sight of / did what the LORD said was evil
decisions.reason: The verdict formula, worded the same way at each level throughout Kings.

decisions.choice: he was not as bad as
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what "not like" means here: his evil was less than theirs.

decisions.choice: "hizo lo malo a los ojos del SEÑOR" (L, B); "hizo lo que el SEÑOR reprueba" (R)
decisions.reason: The verdict formula keeps one wording at each level through Kings, as the terms note sets it.

source.text: עָלָ֣יו עָלָ֔ה שַׁלְמַנְאֶ֖סֶר מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֑וּר וַֽיְהִי־ל֤וֹ הוֹשֵׁ֨עַ֙ עֶ֔בֶד וַיָּ֥שֶׁב ל֖וֹ מִנְחָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Against him came up Shalmaneser king of Assyria, and became to him Hoshea servant and returned to him tribute.

en.L: Against him came up Shalmaneser king of Assyria, and Hoshea became his servant and paid him tribute.
en.B: Shalmaneser king of Assyria marched against him, and Hoshea became his vassal and paid him tribute.
en.R: Shalmaneser, the king of Assyria, marched against Hoshea. Hoshea had to submit to him and pay him tribute.

es.L: Contra él subió Salmanasar, rey de Asiria, y Oseas se hizo su siervo y le pagó tributo.
es.B: Salmanasar, rey de Asiria, marchó contra él, y Oseas se hizo su vasallo y le pagó tributo.
es.R: Salmanasar, el rey de Asiria, marchó contra Oseas. Oseas tuvo que someterse a él y pagarle tributo.

fr.L: Contre lui monta Salmanasar, roi d’Assyrie, et Osée devint son serviteur et lui paya tribut.
fr.B: Salmanasar, roi d’Assyrie, marcha contre lui, et Osée devint son vassal et lui paya tribut.
fr.R: Salmanasar, le roi d’Assyrie, a attaqué Osée. Osée a dû se soumettre à lui et lui payer un tribut.

sw.L: Juu yake akapanda Shalmaneseri mfalme wa Ashuru, naye Hoshea akawa mtumwa wake, akamletea ushuru.
sw.B: Shalmaneseri mfalme wa Ashuru alipanda kumshambulia, naye Hoshea akawa mfalme mtumishi wake, akamlipa ushuru.
sw.R: Shalmaneseri, mfalme wa Ashuru, alikuja kumshambulia Hoshea. Hoshea alilazimika kujitiisha chini yake na kumlipa ushuru.

vi.L: Sanh-ma-na-se vua A-si-ri đi lên đánh ông, và Ô-sê trở thành đầy tớ của vua ấy và nộp cống cho vua ấy.
vi.B: Sanh-ma-na-se vua A-si-ri tiến đánh ông, và Ô-sê phải làm chư hầu và nộp cống cho vua ấy.
vi.R: Sanh-ma-na-se, vua A-si-ri, kéo quân đến đánh Ô-sê. Ô-sê phải quy phục vua ấy và nộp cống cho vua ấy.

ko.L: 그를 치러 앗시리아 왕 살만에셀이 올라왔다. 그리고 호세아가 그의 종이 되어 그에게 조공을 바쳤다.
ko.B: 앗시리아 왕 살만에셀이 그를 치러 올라오자, 호세아는 그의 신하가 되어 그에게 조공을 바쳤다.
ko.R: 앗시리아 왕 살만에셀이 호세아를 치러 왔다. 호세아는 그에게 굴복하여 조공을 바쳐야 했다.

pt.L: Contra ele subiu Salmaneser, rei da Assíria, e Oseias se tornou seu servo e lhe pagou tributo.
pt.B: Salmaneser, rei da Assíria, marchou contra ele, e Oseias se tornou seu vassalo e lhe pagou tributo.
pt.R: Salmaneser, o rei da Assíria, marchou contra Oseias. Oseias teve de se submeter a ele e pagar tributo a ele.

decisions.choice: Shalmaneser king of Assyria: Shalmaneser V
decisions.reason: Shalmaneser V succeeded his father Tiglath-pileser III (16:7-10) and reigned about 727-722 BC. Assyria was then the great power of the Near East.

decisions.choice: servant: a vassal, a subject king
decisions.reason: Here the word for a servant names a king bound by treaty to a greater king, who kept his throne as long as he stayed loyal and paid tribute (16:7; 24:1).

decisions.choice: returned to him tribute: paid him tribute
decisions.reason: "Returned" here means paid back what was owed. The word for tribute is the word for a gift or offering, used of the yearly payment a vassal owed his overlord (verse 4; 1 Kings 5:1).

decisions.choice: servant (Literal); vassal (Balanced); had to submit to him (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "servant" rather than "slave" because the word names a king's political subject, as it does for a king's officials. Balanced uses the exact term for a subject king; Readable describes it.

decisions.choice: "siervo" (L); "vasallo" (B); "tuvo que someterse a él" (R); "Salmanasar"
decisions.reason: The word names a king's political subject (m2); the levels follow the English. "Salmanasar" as the terms note's table gives it.

decisions.choice: "serviteur" (L); "vassal" (B); "a dû se soumettre" (R)
decisions.reason: The word means a subject king (m2); French follows the English at each level.

decisions.choice: mtumwa (Literal); mfalme mtumishi (Balanced); alilazimika kujitiisha chini yake (Readable)
decisions.reason: The word means a vassal, a subject king (meaning decision m2). Balanced says "a servant king", Readable says what it meant for Hoshea. "Kibaraka" (puppet) was set aside as too scornful.

decisions.choice: đầy tớ (L); chư hầu (B); phải quy phục (R)
decisions.reason: The word names a subject king, so Literal says "đầy tớ" rather than "nô lệ"; Balanced gives the political term "chư hầu", Readable a plain verb.

decisions.choice: "종" (L); "신하" (B); "굴복하다" (R)
decisions.reason: The word means a vassal king; Balanced uses "신하", the relation of a subject king to his overlord, and Readable says what it meant for Hoshea.

decisions.choice: Salmaneser, rei da Assíria; servo (L), vassalo (B), teve de se submeter (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the Assyrian king (m1) is "Salmaneser", Portuguese spelling of the sounds of the name, and his title "rei da Assíria" at every level. The subject king (m2) is "servo" at Literal, not "escravo", as the English keeps "servant" for a king's political subject; "vassalo" at Balanced is the exact Portuguese term, and Readable describes it.

source.text: וַיִּמְצָא֩ מֶֽלֶךְ־אַשּׁ֨וּר בְּהוֹשֵׁ֜עַ קֶ֗שֶׁר אֲשֶׁ֨ר שָׁלַ֤ח מַלְאָכִים֙ אֶל־ס֣וֹא מֶֽלֶךְ־מִצְרַ֔יִם וְלֹא־הֶעֱלָ֥ה מִנְחָ֛ה לְמֶ֥לֶךְ אַשּׁ֖וּר כְּשָׁנָ֣ה בְשָׁנָ֑ה וַֽיַּעַצְרֵ֨הוּ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר וַיַּאַסְרֵ֖הוּ בֵּ֥ית כֶּֽלֶא׃

records.literal_gloss: And found [the] king of Assyria in Hoshea conspiracy, that he had sent messengers to So king of Egypt, and not brought up tribute to [the] king of Assyria as year by year; and shut him up [the] king of Assyria and bound him [in a] house of prison.

en.L: And the king of Assyria found conspiracy in Hoshea, for he had sent messengers to So king of Egypt, and he had not brought up tribute to the king of Assyria as [he did] year by year. And the king of Assyria shut him up and bound him in a house of prison.
en.B: But the king of Assyria found Hoshea plotting against him, for he had sent envoys to So king of Egypt and had not paid the king of Assyria his tribute as in other years. So the king of Assyria arrested him and held him bound in prison.
en.R: But the king of Assyria found out that Hoshea was plotting against him. Hoshea had sent messengers to So, the king of Egypt, and he had stopped paying the tribute he had paid the king of Assyria every year. So the king of Assyria arrested Hoshea and put him in prison in chains.

es.L: Y el rey de Asiria halló conspiración en Oseas, porque había enviado mensajeros a So, rey de Egipto, y no había llevado tributo al rey de Asiria como [hacía] año tras año. Y el rey de Asiria lo encerró y lo ató en una casa de prisión.
es.B: Pero el rey de Asiria descubrió que Oseas conspiraba contra él, porque había enviado emisarios a So, rey de Egipto, y no le había pagado al rey de Asiria el tributo como los demás años. Entonces el rey de Asiria lo arrestó y lo tuvo encadenado en la cárcel.
es.R: Pero el rey de Asiria descubrió que Oseas estaba conspirando contra él. Oseas había enviado mensajeros a So, el rey de Egipto, y había dejado de pagar el tributo que le pagaba al rey de Asiria cada año. Por eso el rey de Asiria arrestó a Oseas y lo metió en la cárcel encadenado.

fr.L: Et le roi d’Assyrie trouva une conspiration chez Osée, car il avait envoyé des messagers à So, roi d’Égypte, et il n’avait pas fait monter le tribut au roi d’Assyrie comme d’année en année. Et le roi d’Assyrie l’enferma et le lia dans une maison de prison.
fr.B: Mais le roi d’Assyrie découvrit qu’Osée complotait contre lui : il avait envoyé des émissaires à So, roi d’Égypte, et il n’avait pas versé au roi d’Assyrie son tribut comme les autres années. Alors le roi d’Assyrie le fit arrêter et enchaîner en prison.
fr.R: Mais le roi d’Assyrie a découvert qu’Osée complotait contre lui. Osée avait envoyé des messagers à So, le roi d’Égypte, et il avait cessé de payer le tribut qu’il versait chaque année au roi d’Assyrie. Alors le roi d’Assyrie a fait arrêter Osée et l’a mis en prison, enchaîné.

sw.L: Naye mfalme wa Ashuru akaona fitina katika Hoshea, kwa kuwa alikuwa ametuma wajumbe kwa So mfalme wa Misri, wala hakumpelekea mfalme wa Ashuru ushuru kama [alivyofanya] mwaka kwa mwaka. Naye mfalme wa Ashuru akamfunga, akamtia katika nyumba ya gereza.
sw.B: Lakini mfalme wa Ashuru aligundua kwamba Hoshea alikuwa akifanya njama dhidi yake, kwa kuwa alikuwa ametuma wajumbe kwa So mfalme wa Misri, wala hakuwa amemlipa mfalme wa Ashuru ushuru kama miaka mingine. Basi mfalme wa Ashuru akamkamata, akamfunga gerezani.
sw.R: Lakini mfalme wa Ashuru aligundua kwamba Hoshea alikuwa akipanga njama dhidi yake. Hoshea alikuwa ametuma wajumbe kwa So, mfalme wa Misri, naye alikuwa ameacha kulipa ushuru aliokuwa akimlipa mfalme wa Ashuru kila mwaka. Basi mfalme wa Ashuru akamkamata Hoshea, akamtia gerezani akiwa amefungwa minyororo.

vi.L: Vua A-si-ri thấy Ô-sê có âm mưu phản loạn, vì ông đã sai sứ giả đến Sô vua Ai Cập, và không nộp cống cho vua A-si-ri như [ông vẫn làm] năm này qua năm khác. Vua A-si-ri bắt giam ông và xiềng ông trong ngục.
vi.B: Nhưng vua A-si-ri phát hiện Ô-sê đang mưu phản, vì ông đã sai sứ thần đến Sô vua Ai Cập và không nộp cống cho vua A-si-ri như những năm trước. Vậy vua A-si-ri bắt Ô-sê và xiềng lại trong ngục.
vi.R: Nhưng vua A-si-ri phát hiện Ô-sê đang mưu phản. Ô-sê đã sai sứ giả đến gặp Sô, vua Ai Cập, và đã ngưng nộp số cống mà năm nào ông cũng nộp cho vua A-si-ri. Vậy vua A-si-ri bắt Ô-sê, xiềng lại và bỏ vào ngục.

ko.L: 그리고 앗시리아 왕이 호세아에게서 반역을 발견했다. 그가 이집트 왕 소에게 사자들을 보냈고, 해마다 [하던] 대로 앗시리아 왕에게 조공을 바치지 않았기 때문이다. 그래서 앗시리아 왕이 그를 가두고 감옥에 묶어 두었다.
ko.B: 그러나 앗시리아 왕은 호세아가 반역을 꾀하는 것을 알아냈다. 호세아가 이집트 왕 소에게 사절들을 보내고, 해마다 바치던 조공을 앗시리아 왕에게 바치지 않았던 것이다. 그래서 앗시리아 왕은 그를 붙잡아 감옥에 묶어 가두었다.
ko.R: 그런데 앗시리아 왕은 호세아가 자기를 배반하려 한다는 것을 알게 되었다. 호세아가 이집트 왕 소에게 사람들을 보냈고, 해마다 앗시리아 왕에게 바치던 조공도 더는 바치지 않았던 것이다. 그래서 앗시리아 왕은 호세아를 붙잡아 쇠사슬로 묶어 감옥에 가두었다.

pt.L: E o rei da Assíria achou conspiração em Oseias, porque ele tinha enviado mensageiros a Sô, rei do Egito, e não tinha levado tributo ao rei da Assíria como [fazia] ano após ano. E o rei da Assíria o encerrou e o prendeu em uma casa de prisão.
pt.B: Mas o rei da Assíria descobriu que Oseias conspirava contra ele, pois tinha enviado emissários a Sô, rei do Egito, e não tinha pagado ao rei da Assíria o tributo, como nos outros anos. Então o rei da Assíria o prendeu e o manteve acorrentado na prisão.
pt.R: Mas o rei da Assíria descobriu que Oseias estava conspirando contra ele. Oseias tinha mandado mensageiros a Sô, o rei do Egito, e tinha deixado de pagar o tributo que pagava todo ano ao rei da Assíria. Por isso o rei da Assíria prendeu Oseias e o pôs na prisão acorrentado.

decisions.choice: So king of Egypt: an Egyptian ruler not yet clearly identified
alternatives: to Sais, to the king of Egypt
decisions.reason: No king of Egypt named So is known from Egyptian records. Egypt was then divided among several rulers. So may be a short form of the name of one of them, perhaps Osorkon IV, who ruled in the eastern Delta. Others read the Hebrew letters as the city of Sais, the seat of another ruler: "to Sais, to the king of Egypt". The Hebrew text as it stands reads a personal name.

decisions.choice: conspiracy: rebellion against his overlord
decisions.reason: The word is used for a plot against a king (1 Kings 15:27; 16:20). Here it is a vassal's breaking of his treaty: he sought help from Egypt and stopped paying.

decisions.choice: as year by year: as he had done every year before
decisions.reason: The tribute had been paid yearly; Hoshea now held it back.

decisions.choice: shut him up and bound him: Hoshea was taken before the siege
decisions.reason: Hoshea is in prison before the account of the siege (verse 5) and is not named at the fall of the city. He was probably seized when he came to his overlord, or captured outside the city, and Samaria held out without its king. Verses 5-6 then tell the campaign from its start.

decisions.choice: envoys
decisions.reason: Messengers sent from one king to another are envoys, a word that shows their official errand.

decisions.choice: he had stopped paying the tribute he had paid ... every year
decisions.reason: Readable spells out what "as year by year" means (m3).

decisions.choice: Sô, rei do Egito
decisions.reason: The Egyptian ruler (m1) is written "Sô", with the accent Portuguese needs to show that the one-syllable name is said with an open stressed vowel; without it, "so" would look like a misprint.

source.text: וַיַּ֥עַל מֶֽלֶךְ־אַשּׁ֖וּר בְּכָל־הָאָ֑רֶץ וַיַּ֨עַל֙ שֹׁמְר֔וֹן וַיָּ֥צַר עָלֶ֖יהָ שָׁלֹ֥שׁ שָׁנִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And came up [the] king of Assyria in all the land, and went up [to] Samaria and besieged it three years.

en.L: And the king of Assyria came up into all the land, and he went up to Samaria and besieged it three years.
en.B: Then the king of Assyria invaded the whole land. He went up to Samaria and laid siege to it for three years.
en.R: Then the king of Assyria invaded the whole country. He came to Samaria and surrounded the city with his army for three years.

es.L: Y subió el rey de Asiria por toda la tierra, y subió [a] Samaria y la sitió tres años.
es.B: Entonces el rey de Asiria invadió todo el país. Subió a Samaria y la sitió durante tres años.
es.R: Entonces el rey de Asiria invadió todo el país. Llegó a Samaria y rodeó la ciudad con su ejército durante tres años.

fr.L: Et le roi d’Assyrie monta dans tout le pays, et il monta [à] Samarie et l’assiégea trois ans.
fr.B: Puis le roi d’Assyrie envahit tout le pays. Il monta contre Samarie et l’assiégea pendant trois ans.
fr.R: Ensuite le roi d’Assyrie a envahi tout le pays. Il est venu jusqu’à Samarie et il a encerclé la ville avec son armée pendant trois ans.

sw.L: Naye mfalme wa Ashuru akapanda katika nchi yote, akapanda [hata] Samaria, akauzingira miaka mitatu.
sw.B: Kisha mfalme wa Ashuru akaivamia nchi yote. Akapanda Samaria, akauzingira kwa miaka mitatu.
sw.R: Kisha mfalme wa Ashuru aliivamia nchi yote. Akaja Samaria, akauzunguka mji kwa jeshi lake kwa miaka mitatu.

vi.L: Vua A-si-ri đi lên khắp xứ, đi lên Sa-ma-ri và vây hãm thành ba năm.
vi.B: Rồi vua A-si-ri xâm chiếm toàn xứ. Vua ấy kéo lên Sa-ma-ri và vây hãm thành ba năm.
vi.R: Rồi vua A-si-ri xâm chiếm cả nước. Vua ấy kéo đến Sa-ma-ri và đem quân bao vây thành suốt ba năm.

ko.L: 그리고 앗시리아 왕이 온 땅으로 올라왔고, 사마리아로 올라가 그곳을 삼 년 동안 에워쌌다.
ko.B: 그 뒤에 앗시리아 왕은 온 땅을 침략했다. 그는 사마리아로 올라가 삼 년 동안 그 성을 포위했다.
ko.R: 그 뒤에 앗시리아 왕은 온 나라에 쳐들어왔다. 그는 사마리아로 와서 삼 년 동안 군대로 그 성을 에워쌌다.

pt.L: E o rei da Assíria subiu por toda a terra, e subiu a Samaria e a sitiou três anos.
pt.B: Então o rei da Assíria invadiu toda a terra. Subiu a Samaria e a manteve sitiada durante três anos.
pt.R: Então o rei da Assíria invadiu todo o país. Ele chegou a Samaria e cercou a cidade com o seu exército durante três anos.

decisions.choice: three years: counted inclusively
decisions.reason: 18:9-10 dates the siege from Hoshea's seventh year to his ninth. Counting the first and last years in full, as Kings does, this is three years, though the siege itself may have lasted a little over two.

decisions.choice: came up ... went up: the invasion and then the siege
decisions.reason: The same verb is used twice: first of Assyria's army moving into the land, then of its march up the hill on which Samaria stood (1 Kings 16:24).

decisions.choice: surrounded the city with his army
decisions.reason: Readable explains what a siege is.

source.text: בִּשְׁנַ֨ת הַתְּשִׁיעִ֜ית לְהוֹשֵׁ֗עַ לָכַ֤ד מֶֽלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר֙ אֶת־שֹׁ֣מְר֔וֹן וַיֶּ֥גֶל אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אַשּׁ֑וּרָה וַיֹּ֨שֶׁב אֹתָ֜ם בַּחְלַ֧ח וּבְחָב֛וֹר נְהַ֥ר גּוֹזָ֖ן וְעָרֵ֥י מָדָֽי׃פ

records.literal_gloss: In year the ninth of Hoshea captured [the] king of Assyria Samaria, and exiled Israel to Assyria, and settled them in Halah and on Habor, river of Gozan, and [in the] cities of Media.

en.L: In the ninth year of Hoshea, the king of Assyria captured Samaria, and he exiled Israel to Assyria, and he settled them in Halah and on the Habor, the river of Gozan, and [in the] cities of the Medes.
en.B: In Hoshea's ninth year the king of Assyria captured Samaria and carried the Israelites away into exile to Assyria. He settled them in Halah, on the Habor, Gozan's river, and in the cities of the Medes.
en.R: In the ninth year that Hoshea was king, the king of Assyria captured Samaria. He took the people of Israel away to Assyria as captives. He made them live in Halah, by the Habor River in the region of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes.

es.L: En el año noveno de Oseas, el rey de Asiria tomó Samaria, y llevó cautivo a Israel a Asiria, y los estableció en Halah, y en el Habor, río de Gozán, y [en las] ciudades de los medos.
es.B: En el noveno año de Oseas, el rey de Asiria conquistó Samaria y llevó a los israelitas al destierro en Asiria. Los estableció en Halah, en el Habor, el río de Gozán, y en las ciudades de los medos.
es.R: En el noveno año del reinado de Oseas, el rey de Asiria conquistó Samaria. Se llevó a la gente de Israel a Asiria como prisioneros. Los hizo vivir en Halah, junto al río Habor en la región de Gozán, y en las ciudades de los medos.

fr.L: En la neuvième année d’Osée, le roi d’Assyrie prit Samarie, et il déporta Israël en Assyrie, et il les établit à Halah, et sur le Habor, fleuve de Gozan, et [dans les] villes des Mèdes.
fr.B: La neuvième année d’Osée, le roi d’Assyrie s’empara de Samarie et emmena les Israélites en exil en Assyrie. Il les établit à Halah, sur le Habor, le fleuve de Gozan, et dans les villes des Mèdes.
fr.R: La neuvième année du règne d’Osée, le roi d’Assyrie s’est emparé de Samarie. Il a emmené le peuple d’Israël en Assyrie comme prisonniers. Il les a fait habiter à Halah, au bord du fleuve Habor dans la région de Gozan, et dans les villes des Mèdes.

sw.L: Katika mwaka wa tisa wa Hoshea, mfalme wa Ashuru akaitwaa Samaria, akawahamisha Israeli mpaka Ashuru, akawakalisha katika Hala na kando ya Habori, mto wa Gozani, na [katika] miji ya Wamedi.
sw.B: Katika mwaka wa tisa wa Hoshea, mfalme wa Ashuru aliiteka Samaria, akawachukua Waisraeli uhamishoni mpaka Ashuru. Akawaweka katika Hala, kando ya Habori, mto wa Gozani, na katika miji ya Wamedi.
sw.R: Katika mwaka wa tisa wa utawala wa Hoshea, mfalme wa Ashuru aliiteka Samaria. Akawachukua watu wa Israeli mpaka Ashuru wakiwa mateka. Akawafanya waishi Hala, kando ya mto Habori katika eneo la Gozani, na katika miji ya Wamedi.

vi.L: Năm thứ chín đời Ô-sê, vua A-si-ri chiếm Sa-ma-ri, bắt Y-sơ-ra-ên lưu đày sang A-si-ri, và cho họ định cư tại Ha-la, bên sông Ha-bo, sông của Gô-xan, và [trong] các thành của người Mê-đi.
vi.B: Năm thứ chín đời Ô-sê, vua A-si-ri chiếm Sa-ma-ri và bắt dân Y-sơ-ra-ên lưu đày sang A-si-ri. Vua ấy cho họ định cư tại Ha-la, bên sông Ha-bo, sông của Gô-xan, và trong các thành của người Mê-đi.
vi.R: Năm thứ chín đời Ô-sê làm vua, vua A-si-ri chiếm được Sa-ma-ri. Vua ấy bắt dân Y-sơ-ra-ên đem sang A-si-ri làm tù binh. Vua ấy cho họ sống tại Ha-la, bên sông Ha-bo trong vùng Gô-xan, và trong các thành của người Mê-đi.

ko.L: 호세아의 제구년에 앗시리아 왕이 사마리아를 점령하고 이스라엘을 앗시리아로 사로잡아 갔다. 그리고 그들을 할라와 고산 강 하볼 가와 메대 사람들의 성읍들에 살게 했다.
ko.B: 호세아가 다스린 지 구 년째 되는 해에 앗시리아 왕은 사마리아를 점령하고 이스라엘 사람들을 앗시리아로 사로잡아 갔다. 그는 그들을 할라와 고산 강 하볼 가와 메대 사람들의 성읍들에 살게 했다.
ko.R: 호세아가 왕이 된 지 구 년째 되는 해에 앗시리아 왕은 사마리아를 점령했다. 그는 이스라엘 백성을 포로로 잡아 앗시리아로 끌고 갔다. 그는 그들을 할라와, 고산 지방의 하볼 강 가와, 메대 사람들의 성읍들에서 살게 했다.

pt.L: No nono ano de Oseias, o rei da Assíria tomou Samaria, e levou Israel para o exílio na Assíria, e os fez habitar em Hala, e junto ao Habor, o rio de Gozã, e [nas] cidades dos medos.
pt.B: No nono ano de Oseias, o rei da Assíria conquistou Samaria e levou os israelitas para o exílio na Assíria. Ele os estabeleceu em Hala, junto ao Habor, o rio de Gozã, e nas cidades dos medos.
pt.R: No nono ano em que Oseias era rei, o rei da Assíria conquistou Samaria. Ele levou o povo de Israel como prisioneiro para a Assíria. Fez com que morassem em Hala, perto do rio Habor, na região de Gozã, e nas cidades dos medos.

decisions.choice: the king of Assyria captured Samaria: the end of the northern kingdom, about 722 BC
decisions.reason: The writer does not name the king. Shalmaneser V died about the time the city fell, and his successor Sargon II claims in his own inscriptions to have taken Samaria and deported its people. The kingdom of Israel, which had stood about two hundred years since the division (1 Kings 12), ended here.

decisions.choice: exiled: carried the people away from their land
decisions.reason: The verb means to remove a people into exile. Assyria moved conquered peoples to distant parts of its empire and brought others in to replace them (verse 24), so that they could not easily rebel. The same verb was used of the nations Yahweh removed before Israel (verse 11).

decisions.choice: Halah, the Habor, the river of Gozan, the cities of the Medes
decisions.reason: Halah lay in Assyria, north and east of Nineveh. The Habor is a river of upper Mesopotamia that flows south into the Euphrates; Gozan was a city and district on it. Media lay further east, in the mountains of what is now Iran, which Assyria had brought under its rule. The same list appears in 18:11.

decisions.choice: the Israelites (Balanced); the people of Israel (Readable)
decisions.reason: "Israel" here is the people, not the land or the kingdom, so Balanced and Readable say so.

decisions.choice: by the Habor River in the region of Gozan
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear that the Habor is the river and Gozan the district on it.

decisions.choice: "Israel" (L); "los israelitas" (B); "la gente de Israel" (R); "Halah", "el Habor", "Gozán", "los medos"
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say that the people are meant, as the English does; the places in their usual Spanish forms.

decisions.choice: akawahamisha (Literal); akawachukua uhamishoni (Balanced); akawachukua ... wakiwa mateka (Readable)
decisions.reason: The verb of exile, carrying a people away from their land, used through the end of Kings: "kuhamisha" (Literal), "kuchukua uhamishoni" (Balanced), "kuchukua mateka" (Readable).

decisions.choice: "사로잡아 가다" (L, B); "포로로 잡아 끌고 가다" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb of exile keeps one wording per level through these chapters; Readable says plainly that the people were taken as captives.

decisions.choice: tomou (L), conquistou (B, R) Samaria; levou ... para o exílio (L, B), levou ... como prisioneiro (R); Hala, o Habor, Gozã, os medos
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the exile (m2) is "levar para o exílio" at Literal and Balanced, the words 16:9 uses for Damascus, and Readable says what it meant, as the English does. The places (m3) take their usual Brazilian forms, "Hala", "Habor", "Gozã" (with the nasal ending Portuguese writes for "-an", as in "Harã"), and the people "os medos".

source.text: וַיְהִ֗י כִּֽי־חָטְא֤וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לַיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֔ם הַמַּעֲלֶ֤ה אֹתָם֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם מִתַּ֕חַת יַ֖ד פַּרְעֹ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ־מִצְרָ֑יִם וַיִּֽירְא֖וּ אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was because sinned [the] sons of Israel against Yahweh their God, who brought up them from [the] land of Egypt, from under [the] hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and they feared other gods.

en.L: And it was so because the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel had sinned against {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God, who had brought them up from the land of Egypt, from under the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and they had feared other gods.
en.B: This happened because the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} had sinned against {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God, who had brought them up from the land of Egypt and out from under the power of Pharaoh king of Egypt. They had feared other gods.
en.R: All this happened because the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} had sinned against {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God. He had brought them out of Egypt and freed them from the power of Pharaoh, the king of Egypt. But they worshiped other gods.

es.L: Y fue así porque los hijos de Israel habían pecado contra {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios, que los había hecho subir de la tierra de Egipto, de debajo de la mano del faraón, rey de Egipto, y habían temido a otros dioses.
es.B: Esto sucedió porque los israelitas habían pecado contra {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios, que los había sacado de la tierra de Egipto y del poder del faraón, rey de Egipto. Habían temido a otros dioses.
es.R: Todo esto sucedió porque los israelitas habían pecado contra {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios. Él los había sacado de Egipto y los había librado del poder del faraón, el rey de Egipto. Pero ellos adoraron a otros dioses.

fr.L: Et cela arriva parce que les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël avaient péché contre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur Dieu, qui les avait fait monter du pays d’Égypte, de dessous la main du pharaon, roi d’Égypte, et ils avaient craint d’autres dieux.
fr.B: Cela arriva parce que les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} avaient péché contre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur Dieu, qui les avait fait monter du pays d’Égypte et soustraits au pouvoir du pharaon, roi d’Égypte. Ils avaient craint d’autres dieux.
fr.R: Tout cela est arrivé parce que les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} avaient péché contre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur Dieu. Il les avait fait sortir d’Égypte et les avait libérés du pouvoir du pharaon, le roi d’Égypte. Mais ils ont adoré d’autres dieux.

sw.L: Na ikawa hivyo kwa sababu wana wa Israeli walikuwa wamemtenda dhambi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao, aliyewapandisha kutoka nchi ya Misri, kutoka chini ya mkono wa Farao mfalme wa Misri, nao walikuwa wameicha miungu mingine.
sw.B: Hayo yalitokea kwa sababu Waisraeli walikuwa wamemtenda dhambi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao, aliyewatoa katika nchi ya Misri na kuwaokoa chini ya nguvu za Farao mfalme wa Misri. Walikuwa wameicha miungu mingine.
sw.R: Hayo yote yalitokea kwa sababu Waisraeli walikuwa wamemtenda dhambi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao. Yeye ndiye aliyewatoa Misri na kuwaweka huru kutoka katika utawala wa Farao, mfalme wa Misri. Lakini waliiabudu miungu mingine.

vi.L: Việc ấy xảy ra vì con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên đã phạm tội với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ, là Đấng đã đem họ lên khỏi đất Ai Cập, khỏi dưới tay Pha-ra-ôn vua Ai Cập, và họ đã kính sợ các thần khác.
vi.B: Việc này xảy ra vì dân Y-sơ-ra-ên đã phạm tội với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ, là Đấng đã đem họ lên khỏi đất Ai Cập, thoát khỏi quyền lực của Pha-ra-ôn vua Ai Cập. Họ đã kính sợ các thần khác.
vi.R: Mọi việc này xảy ra vì dân Y-sơ-ra-ên đã phạm tội với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ. Ngài đã đem họ ra khỏi Ai Cập và giải thoát họ khỏi quyền lực của Pha-ra-ôn, vua Ai Cập. Nhưng họ lại thờ phượng các thần khác.

ko.L: 그리고 [이 일이 일어난 것은] 이스라엘 자손이 그들을 이집트 땅에서, 곧 이집트 왕 바로의 손 아래에서 이끌어 올리신 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 죄를 짓고, 다른 신들을 경외했기 때문이다.
ko.B: 이런 일이 일어난 것은 이스라엘 자손이 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 죄를 지었기 때문이다. 그분께서는 그들을 이집트 땅에서 이끌어 올리시고 이집트 왕 바로의 손에서 건져 내셨다. 그런데도 그들은 다른 신들을 경외했다.
ko.R: 이 모든 일이 일어난 것은 이스라엘 사람들이 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 죄를 지었기 때문이다. 그분께서는 그들을 이집트에서 데리고 나오시고 이집트 왕 바로의 손에서 자유롭게 해 주셨다. 그런데도 그들은 다른 신들을 섬겼다.

pt.L: E isso aconteceu porque os filhos de Israel tinham pecado contra {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o seu Deus, que os tinha feito subir da terra do Egito, de debaixo da mão de Faraó, rei do Egito, e tinham temido outros deuses.
pt.B: Isso aconteceu porque os israelitas tinham pecado contra {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o seu Deus, que os tinha feito subir da terra do Egito e os tinha tirado do poder de Faraó, rei do Egito. Eles tinham temido outros deuses.
pt.R: Tudo isso aconteceu porque os israelitas tinham pecado contra {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o seu Deus. Ele os tinha tirado do Egito e os tinha libertado do poder de Faraó, o rei do Egito. Mas eles adoraram outros deuses.

decisions.choice: and it was because: the start of the writer's explanation
decisions.reason: Here the account turns from what happened to why it happened. Verses 7-23 look back over Israel's whole history and give the reason for the fall: not Assyria's strength but Israel's sin against its God.

decisions.choice: who brought them up from Egypt: the ground of the covenant
decisions.reason: The first of the Ten Commandments begins with the same act: "I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt", and goes on, "You shall have no other gods before me" (Exodus 20:2-3). The sin is ingratitude to the God who freed them.

decisions.choice: feared other gods: revered and worshiped them
decisions.reason: To fear a god is to stand in awe of him and worship him. The word runs through this chapter: Israel feared other gods (verses 7, 35, 37, 38), and the new settlers feared Yahweh and their own gods together (verses 32-33, 41).

decisions.choice: feared (Literal, Balanced); worshiped (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable gives the sense of "feared" here (m3). Literal and Balanced keep "feared" so the chapter's repeated word stays visible (verses 25-41).

decisions.choice: the power of
decisions.reason: "Hand" stands for power or control, as often.

decisions.choice: "temer" (L, B); "adorar" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep "temer", the word this chapter turns on (verses 25-41); Readable gives its sense, "adorar", as the English does (m3). This holds through the chapter.

decisions.choice: "craint" (L, B); "adoré" (R)
decisions.reason: To fear a god is to revere and worship him (m3); Literal and Balanced keep the Hebrew verb, Readable says what it meant, as the English does. For verses 7-23, the writer's explanation of the fall is narrated in the pluperfect where it looks back on Israel's history.

decisions.choice: kucha (Literal, Balanced: wameicha miungu mingine); kuabudu (Readable)
decisions.reason: "Fear" of a god in this chapter is reverence and worship (meaning decision m3). Literal and Balanced use "kucha", the Swahili verb for fearing God with reverence ("kumcha BWANA"), rather than "kuogopa", which is to be afraid; Readable says "kuabudu", worship, as the English does. Used through verses 25-41.

decisions.choice: "경외하다" (L, B); "섬기다" (R) for "fear" (gods, and the LORD in verses 25-41)
decisions.reason: The fear meant here is reverence shown in worship; "두려워하다" would suggest mere fright. Readable says "섬기다", as the English Readable says "worship".

decisions.choice: kính sợ (L, B); thờ phượng (R)
decisions.reason: "Fear" of a god is reverence and worship (m3): Literal and Balanced say "kính sợ", the word this chapter turns on through verse 41, and Readable "thờ phượng". Plain "sợ" would mean being afraid.

decisions.choice: temer (L, B); adorar (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole chapter (verses 7, 25, 28, 32-41): "temer" at Literal and Balanced keeps visible the word the chapter turns on (m3), as the English keeps "fear", and as Deuteronomy 6:13 says it in Portuguese; Readable says "adorar", what the word means here. "Faraó" has no article, as the English has none (Old Testament terms).

source.text: וַיֵּֽלְכוּ֙ בְּחֻקּ֣וֹת הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר֙ הוֹרִ֣ישׁ יְהוָ֔ה מִפְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּמַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשֽׂוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And they walked in [the] statutes of the nations whom drove out Yahweh from before [the] sons of Israel, and [of the] kings of Israel which they made.

en.L: And they walked in the statutes of the nations whom {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had driven out before the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel, and [in those] of the kings of Israel, which they made.
en.B: They walked in the statutes of the nations whom {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had driven out before the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}, and in the statutes that the kings of Israel had made.
en.R: They lived by the laws of the nations that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had driven out of the land ahead of the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}. They also followed the laws that the kings of Israel had made.

es.L: Y anduvieron en los estatutos de las naciones que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había expulsado de delante de los hijos de Israel, y [en los] de los reyes de Israel, que ellos hicieron.
es.B: Anduvieron en los estatutos de las naciones que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había expulsado de delante de los israelitas, y en los estatutos que habían hecho los reyes de Israel.
es.R: Vivieron según las leyes de las naciones que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había echado de la tierra para dar lugar a los israelitas. También siguieron las leyes que habían hecho los reyes de Israel.

fr.L: Et ils marchèrent dans les prescriptions des nations que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait chassées devant les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël, et [dans celles] des rois d’Israël, qu’ils avaient faites.
fr.B: Ils avaient suivi les prescriptions des nations que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait chassées devant les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}, et celles que les rois d’Israël avaient instituées.
fr.R: Ils avaient vécu selon les lois des peuples que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait chassés du pays devant les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}. Ils avaient aussi suivi les lois que les rois d’Israël avaient établies.

sw.L: Nao wakaenenda katika amri za mataifa ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyafukuza mbele ya wana wa Israeli, na [katika zile] za wafalme wa Israeli, walizozifanya.
sw.B: Walienenda katika amri za mataifa ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyafukuza mbele ya Waisraeli, na katika amri zilizowekwa na wafalme wa Israeli.
sw.R: Waliishi kwa kufuata sheria za mataifa ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyafukuza kutoka katika nchi mbele ya Waisraeli. Pia walifuata sheria walizoziweka wafalme wa Israeli.

vi.L: Họ đi theo các luật lệ của các dân tộc mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đuổi khỏi trước mặt con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên, và [theo luật lệ] của các vua Y-sơ-ra-ên mà họ đã lập.
vi.B: Họ đi theo luật lệ của các dân tộc mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đuổi đi trước mặt dân Y-sơ-ra-ên, và theo luật lệ mà các vua Y-sơ-ra-ên đã lập.
vi.R: Họ sống theo luật lệ của các dân tộc mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đuổi ra khỏi xứ trước mặt dân Y-sơ-ra-ên. Họ cũng theo các luật lệ mà các vua Y-sơ-ra-ên đã đặt ra.

ko.L: 그리고 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘 자손 앞에서 쫓아내신 민족들의 규례와, 이스라엘 왕들이 만든 [규례]를 따라 걸었다.
ko.B: 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘 자손 앞에서 쫓아내신 민족들의 규례를 따랐고, 이스라엘 왕들이 만든 규례도 따랐다.
ko.R: 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘 사람들 앞에서 그 땅에서 쫓아내신 민족들의 법을 따라 살았다. 또 이스라엘 왕들이 만든 법도 따랐다.

pt.L: E andaram nos estatutos das nações que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha expulsado de diante dos filhos de Israel, e [nos] dos reis de Israel, que eles fizeram.
pt.B: Eles andaram nos estatutos das nações que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha expulsado de diante dos israelitas, e nos estatutos que os reis de Israel tinham feito.
pt.R: Eles viveram segundo as leis das nações que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha expulsado da terra para dar lugar aos israelitas. Também seguiram as leis que os reis de Israel tinham feito.

decisions.choice: the statutes of the nations: the customs the nations lived by, above all in worship
decisions.reason: The word is the one used for Yahweh's statutes (verses 13, 15, 34, 37). Here it is set against them: Israel kept the nations' rules instead of its God's. Leviticus 18:3 and 20:23 forbid walking in the statutes of the nations of Canaan.

decisions.choice: and of the kings of Israel which they made: the practices the kings of Israel set up
alternatives: and [walked after] the kings of Israel whom they made
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is brief. It most likely means the statutes the kings of Israel made, such as Jeroboam's calves with their priests and feasts (1 Kings 12:28-33; verses 21-22). It can also be read "and the kings of Israel whom they made", that is, the kings Israel set up for itself (Hosea 8:4).

decisions.choice: whom Yahweh had driven out: Israel copied the nations that lost the land
decisions.reason: The nations were driven out for these practices (Leviticus 18:24-28). By copying them, Israel brought the same end on itself.

decisions.choice: statutes (Literal, Balanced); laws (Readable)
decisions.reason: The settled wording for this word in these books, kept here so the contrast with Yahweh's statutes later in the chapter is visible.

decisions.choice: "estatutos" (L, B); "leyes" (R)
decisions.reason: One word per level for this term, following the English, so that the contrast with Yahweh's statutes later in the chapter is heard.

decisions.choice: amri (Literal, Balanced); sheria (Readable)
decisions.reason: "Statutes" in this chapter: "amri" at Literal and Balanced, "sheria" at Readable, as the English says "laws".

decisions.choice: "규례" (L, B), "법" (R) for statutes; through verses 34-37 also "법도" (judgments), "율법" (law), "계명" (commandment), and at Readable "법, 규칙, 가르침, 명령"
decisions.reason: Each of the four law words keeps one Korean word per level through the chapter, so the list in verses 34 and 37 reads the same both times.

decisions.choice: andaram nos estatutos das nações (L, B); viveram segundo as leis das nações (R)
decisions.reason: The phrase (m1) keeps the words Leviticus 18:3 gives the law it breaks in Portuguese, "andar nos estatutos", and the word for statutes the chapter uses again for the LORD's own (verses 13, 15, 34, 37): "estatutos" at Literal and Balanced and "leis" at Readable, as 1 Kings 2:3 sets these terms.

source.text: וַיְחַפְּא֣וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל דְּבָרִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־כֵ֔ן עַל־יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֑ם וַיִּבְנ֨וּ לָהֶ֤ם בָּמוֹת֙ בְּכָל־עָ֣רֵיהֶ֔ם מִמִּגְדַּ֥ל נוֹצְרִ֖ים עַד־עִ֥יר מִבְצָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And did secretly [the] sons of Israel things which [were] not right against Yahweh their God, and built for themselves high places in all their cities, from tower of watchmen to city fortified.

en.L: And the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel did secretly things that [were] not right against {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God, and they built for themselves high places in all their cities, from watchmen's tower to fortified city.
en.B: In secret the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} did things against {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God that were not right. They built high places for themselves in all their towns, from the watchtower to the fortified city.
en.R: The {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} secretly did wrong things against {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God. They built hilltop shrines for themselves in all their towns, from the smallest lookout tower to the largest walled city.

es.L: Y los hijos de Israel hicieron en secreto cosas que no [eran] rectas contra {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios, y se edificaron lugares altos en todas sus ciudades, desde la torre de los vigías hasta la ciudad fortificada.
es.B: A escondidas, los israelitas hicieron contra {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios cosas que no eran rectas. Se construyeron lugares altos en todas sus ciudades, desde la torre de vigilancia hasta la ciudad fortificada.
es.R: Los israelitas hicieron en secreto cosas malas contra {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios. Se construyeron santuarios sobre las colinas en todas sus ciudades, desde la torre de vigilancia más pequeña hasta la ciudad amurallada más grande.

fr.L: Et les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël firent en secret contre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur Dieu des choses qui [n’étaient] pas droites, et ils se bâtirent des hauts lieux dans toutes leurs villes, depuis la tour des guetteurs jusqu’à la ville fortifiée.
fr.B: En secret, les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} avaient commis contre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur Dieu des actes qui n’étaient pas justes. Ils s’étaient bâti des hauts lieux dans toutes leurs villes, depuis la tour de guet jusqu’à la ville fortifiée.
fr.R: Les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} avaient fait en secret de mauvaises choses contre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur Dieu. Ils s’étaient construit des sanctuaires sur les collines dans toutes leurs villes, depuis la plus petite tour de garde jusqu’à la plus grande ville fortifiée.

sw.L: Na wana wa Israeli wakafanya kwa siri mambo yasiyokuwa sawa juu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao, wakajijengea mahali pa juu katika miji yao yote, tangu mnara wa walinzi mpaka mji wenye ngome.
sw.B: Kwa siri Waisraeli walifanya mambo yasiyo sawa dhidi ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao. Walijijengea mahali pa juu katika miji yao yote, tangu mnara wa walinzi mpaka mji wenye ngome.
sw.R: Waisraeli walifanya kwa siri mambo mabaya dhidi ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao. Walijijengea patakatifu pa kilimani katika miji yao yote, tangu mnara mdogo kabisa wa walinzi mpaka mji mkubwa kabisa wenye kuta.

vi.L: Con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên lén lút làm những điều không đúng với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ, và xây cho mình các nơi cao trong mọi thành của họ, từ tháp canh đến thành kiên cố.
vi.B: Con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên lén lút làm những điều sai trái nghịch với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ. Họ xây cho mình các nơi cao trong mọi thành, từ tháp canh cho đến thành kiên cố.
vi.R: Dân Y-sơ-ra-ên lén lút làm những điều sai trái nghịch với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ. Họ xây cho mình những nơi thờ phượng trên đồi cao trong mọi thành, từ tháp canh nhỏ nhất đến thành có tường bao lớn nhất.

ko.L: 그리고 이스라엘 자손이 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 옳지 않은 일들을 은밀히 행했고, 망대에서부터 견고한 성읍에 이르기까지 그들의 모든 성읍에 자기들을 위해 산당들을 지었다.
ko.B: 이스라엘 자손은 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 옳지 않은 일들을 몰래 행했다. 그들은 망대에서부터 요새화된 성읍에 이르기까지 그들의 모든 성읍에 산당들을 지었다.
ko.R: 이스라엘 사람들은 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 몰래 잘못된 일들을 했다. 그들은 가장 작은 망대에서부터 가장 큰 성벽 도시에 이르기까지 그들의 모든 성읍에 산꼭대기 제단을 지었다.

pt.L: E os filhos de Israel fizeram às escondidas coisas que não [eram] retas contra {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o seu Deus, e edificaram para si altos em todas as suas cidades, desde a torre dos vigias até a cidade fortificada.
pt.B: Às escondidas, os israelitas fizeram contra {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o seu Deus, coisas que não eram retas. Construíram para si altos em todas as suas cidades, desde a torre de vigia até a cidade fortificada.
pt.R: Os israelitas fizeram em segredo coisas erradas contra {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o seu Deus. Construíram para si santuários no alto dos morros em todas as suas cidades, desde a menor torre de vigia até a maior cidade com muralhas.

decisions.choice: did secretly: the meaning of a rare verb
decisions.reason: This verb occurs only here. It is usually linked to a word meaning "to cover", so "did in secret" or "covered over": they hid their wrongdoing or dressed it up as the worship of Yahweh. Others take it as "did things against" or "spoke things against" Yahweh.

decisions.choice: from watchmen's tower to fortified city: everywhere
decisions.reason: The phrase runs from the smallest place where people lived, a lookout tower in the fields, to the largest walled town (18:8). There was no settlement without its shrine.

decisions.choice: high places: local shrines
decisions.reason: Shrines with altars, often on hills, where sacrifice was made outside the temple (1 Kings 3:2; 14:23).

decisions.choice: hilltop shrines
decisions.reason: The Readable wording kept for high places in these books.

decisions.choice: the smallest ... the largest
decisions.reason: Readable adds "smallest" and "largest" so the point of the phrase is clear (m2).

source.text: וַיַּצִּ֧בוּ לָהֶ֛ם מַצֵּב֖וֹת וַאֲשֵׁרִ֑ים עַ֚ל כָּל־גִּבְעָ֣ה גְבֹהָ֔ה וְתַ֖חַת כָּל־עֵ֥ץ רַעֲנָֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And set up for themselves standing stones and Asherah poles on every hill high and under every tree green.

en.L: And they set up for themselves standing stones and Asherah poles on every high hill and under every leafy tree.
en.B: They set up standing stones and Asherah poles for themselves on every high hill and under every leafy tree.
en.R: They set up stone pillars and poles used to worship Asherah on every high hill and under every large, leafy tree.

es.L: Y se levantaron estelas y postes de Aserá sobre toda colina alta y debajo de todo árbol frondoso.
es.B: Se levantaron piedras sagradas y postes de Aserá sobre toda colina alta y debajo de todo árbol frondoso.
es.R: Levantaron las piedras que levantan para adorar a los dioses y los postes que usaban para adorar a Aserá sobre toda colina alta y debajo de todo árbol grande y frondoso.

fr.L: Et ils se dressèrent des stèles et des poteaux d’Ashéra sur toute colline élevée et sous tout arbre verdoyant.
fr.B: Ils s’étaient dressé des pierres dressées et des poteaux d’Ashéra sur toute colline élevée et sous tout arbre verdoyant.
fr.R: Ils avaient installé des pierres dressées et des poteaux sacrés de la déesse Ashéra sur chaque haute colline et sous chaque grand arbre au feuillage épais.

sw.L: Nao wakajisimamishia nguzo za mawe na miti ya Ashera juu ya kila kilima kirefu na chini ya kila mti wenye majani mengi.
sw.B: Walijisimamishia nguzo za mawe na miti ya Ashera juu ya kila kilima kirefu na chini ya kila mti wenye majani mengi.
sw.R: Walisimamisha nguzo za mawe na nguzo za kumwabudu mungu wa kike Ashera juu ya kila kilima kirefu na chini ya kila mti mkubwa wenye majani mengi.

vi.L: Họ dựng cho mình các trụ đá và các trụ A-sê-ra trên mọi đồi cao và dưới mọi cây xanh rậm lá.
vi.B: Họ dựng cho mình các trụ đá và các trụ A-sê-ra trên mọi đồi cao và dưới mọi cây xanh rậm lá.
vi.R: Họ dựng các trụ đá và các trụ dùng để thờ nữ thần A-sê-ra trên mọi đồi cao và dưới mọi cây lớn rậm lá.

ko.L: 그리고 그들은 모든 높은 언덕 위와 모든 푸른 나무 아래에 자기들을 위해 돌기둥들과 아세라 목상들을 세웠다.
ko.B: 그들은 높은 언덕마다 그리고 잎이 무성한 나무 아래마다 돌기둥과 아세라 목상을 세웠다.
ko.R: 그들은 높은 언덕마다 그리고 잎이 무성한 큰 나무 아래마다 돌기둥과 아세라를 섬기는 데 쓰는 목상을 세웠다.

pt.L: E levantaram para si colunas e postes de Aserá sobre toda colina alta e debaixo de toda árvore verdejante.
pt.B: Levantaram para si colunas sagradas e postes de Aserá em toda colina alta e debaixo de toda árvore frondosa.
pt.R: Levantaram colunas de pedra usadas no culto e postes usados para adorar a deusa Aserá em toda colina alta e debaixo de toda árvore grande e frondosa.

decisions.choice: standing stones and Asherah poles: objects of Canaanite worship
decisions.reason: Standing stones were upright stones set up as sacred markers; Asherah poles were wooden poles or trees that stood for the goddess Asherah. The law ordered Israel to break down both (Exodus 34:13; Deuteronomy 16:21-22).

decisions.choice: on every high hill and under every leafy tree: the places where the nations worshiped
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy 12:2 commands Israel to destroy the places where the nations served their gods, on the hills and under every leafy tree. Judah built such places (1 Kings 14:23), Ahaz worshiped there (16:4), and Israel did the same.

decisions.choice: leafy: green and flourishing
decisions.reason: The word describes a tree in full leaf, green and flourishing; it is worded as in 1 Kings 14:23 and 16:4. Such shady trees were favored places for worship of fertility gods.

decisions.choice: standing stones, Asherah poles (Literal, Balanced); stone pillars, poles used to worship Asherah (Readable)
decisions.reason: The wording kept for these words in Samuel and Kings.

decisions.choice: "estelas" (L); "piedras sagradas" (B); "las piedras que levantan para adorar" (R); "postes de Aserá"
decisions.reason: As the Kings and Chronicles terms note sets for standing stones and Asherah poles; Readable explains both, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "stèles" (L), "pierres dressées" (B, R); "poteaux d'Ashéra" (L, B), "poteaux sacrés de la déesse Ashéra" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's French for standing stones and Asherah poles; Readable says whose poles they were, as the English does.

decisions.choice: nguzo za mawe; miti ya Ashera (Readable: nguzo za kumwabudu mungu wa kike Ashera)
decisions.reason: Standing stones and Asherah poles in the terms note's wording.

decisions.choice: các trụ đá; các trụ A-sê-ra (R: trụ dùng để thờ nữ thần A-sê-ra)
decisions.reason: The terms note wording for standing stones and Asherah poles; Readable says what the poles were for.

decisions.choice: "돌기둥" and "아세라 목상" (R: "아세라를 섬기는 데 쓰는 목상")
decisions.reason: The terms note's words for standing stones and Asherah poles.

decisions.choice: colunas (L), colunas sagradas (B), colunas de pedra usadas no culto (R); postes de Aserá (L, B), postes usados para adorar a deusa Aserá (R)
decisions.reason: The objects (m1) and the places (m2) keep, level by level, the words of Deuteronomy 12:2-3 and 1 Kings 14:23 in Portuguese, so that the echo of the law is kept.

source.text: וַיְקַטְּרוּ־שָׁם֙ בְּכָל־בָּמ֔וֹת כַּגּוֹיִ֕ם אֲשֶׁר־הֶגְלָ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה מִפְּנֵיהֶ֑ם וַֽיַּעֲשׂוּ֙ דְּבָרִ֣ים רָעִ֔ים לְהַכְעִ֖יס אֶת־יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And burned incense there on all high places like the nations whom exiled Yahweh from before them, and did things evil to provoke Yahweh.

en.L: And they burned incense there on all the high places, like the nations whom {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had carried away before them, and they did evil things to provoke {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} to anger.
en.B: There on all the high places they burned incense, as the nations had done whom {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} carried away before them, and they did evil things that provoked {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} to anger.
en.R: They burned incense at all the hilltop shrines, as the nations had done before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} removed them from the land. They did evil things that made {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} angry.

es.L: Y quemaron incienso allí en todos los lugares altos, como las naciones que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había desterrado de delante de ellos, e hicieron cosas malas para provocar a ira {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.B: Allí, en todos los lugares altos, quemaron incienso, como habían hecho las naciones que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había desterrado de delante de ellos, e hicieron cosas malas que provocaron a ira {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.R: Quemaron incienso en todos los santuarios sobre las colinas, como lo habían hecho las naciones antes de que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} las echara de la tierra. Hicieron cosas malas que hicieron enojar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et ils brûlèrent là de l’encens sur tous les hauts lieux, comme les nations que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait déportées devant eux, et ils firent des choses mauvaises pour irriter {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Là, sur tous les hauts lieux, ils avaient brûlé de l’encens comme les nations que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait déportées devant eux, et ils avaient commis des actions mauvaises qui irritaient {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Ils avaient brûlé de l’encens dans tous les sanctuaires sur les collines, comme le faisaient les peuples avant que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} les enlève du pays. Ils avaient fait des choses mauvaises qui ont mis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} en colère.

sw.L: Nao wakafukiza uvumba huko mahali pa juu pote, kama mataifa ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyahamisha mbele yao, wakafanya mambo mabaya ya kumkasirisha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Huko mahali pa juu pote walifukiza uvumba, kama mataifa ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyahamisha mbele yao yalivyofanya, nao wakafanya mambo mabaya yaliyomkasirisha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Walifukiza uvumba katika patakatifu pote pa kilimani, kama mataifa yalivyofanya kabla {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hajayaondoa katika nchi. Walifanya mambo mabaya yaliyomkasirisha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Tại đó, trên mọi nơi cao, họ đốt hương như các dân tộc mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đày đi khỏi trước mặt họ, và họ làm những điều ác để chọc giận {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Tại đó, trên mọi nơi cao, họ đốt hương như các dân tộc mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đày đi trước mặt họ, và họ làm những điều ác chọc giận {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Họ đốt hương tại mọi nơi thờ phượng trên đồi cao, như các dân tộc đã làm trước khi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đuổi họ ra khỏi xứ. Họ làm những điều ác khiến {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nổi giận.

ko.L: 그리고 그들은 거기 모든 산당에서, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들 앞에서 사로잡아 가게 하신 민족들처럼 분향했고, 악한 일들을 행하여 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 노엽게 했다.
ko.B: 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들 앞에서 쫓아내신 민족들이 하던 대로 거기 모든 산당에서 분향했다. 그리고 악한 일들을 행하여 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 진노를 일으켰다.
ko.R: 그들은 모든 산꼭대기 제단에서 향을 피웠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그 땅에서 몰아내신 민족들이 전에 하던 그대로였다. 그들은 악한 일을 하여 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 화나시게 했다.

pt.L: E queimaram incenso ali, em todos os altos, como as nações que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha levado embora de diante deles, e fizeram coisas más para provocar à ira {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.B: Ali, em todos os altos, queimaram incenso, como tinham feito as nações que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} levou embora de diante deles, e fizeram coisas más que provocaram {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} à ira.
pt.R: Eles queimaram incenso em todos os santuários no alto dos morros, como as nações faziam antes que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} as tirasse da terra. Fizeram coisas más que deixaram {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} irado.

decisions.choice: burned incense: made offerings go up in smoke
decisions.reason: The verb means to make something go up in smoke as an offering. It can refer to incense or to the burning of sacrifices; at the high places it probably covers both (1 Kings 3:3).

decisions.choice: whom Yahweh had carried away: removed from the land
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used of Israel's exile in verse 6. The writer draws the parallel: the nations were removed for these practices, and now Israel has been removed for the same.

decisions.choice: to provoke to anger
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 16:2, the people's sin rouses Yahweh's anger (verse 17).

decisions.choice: carried away (Literal, Balanced); removed them from the land (Readable)
decisions.reason: The verb usually means "take into exile"; here it is used of the nations driven out of Canaan, and "carried away" keeps the link to verse 6 without suggesting a deportation like Assyria's.

decisions.choice: provoke to anger (Literal, Balanced); made angry (Readable)
decisions.reason: The formula as in 1 Kings 16:2.

decisions.choice: "provocar a ira" (L, B); "hicieron enojar" (R)
decisions.reason: The formula of provoking Yahweh keeps one wording at each level, following the English.

source.text: וַיַּֽעַבְד֖וּ הַגִּלֻּלִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ לָהֶ֔ם לֹ֥א תַעֲשׂ֖וּ אֶת־הַדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And they served the idols, which said Yahweh to them, Not you shall do the thing the this.

en.L: And they served the idols, of which {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had said to them, "You shall not do this thing."
en.B: They served the idols, though {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had told them, "You must not do this."
en.R: They worshiped idols, even though {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had told them, "Do not do this."

es.L: Y sirvieron a los ídolos, de los cuales {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} les había dicho: «No {{plural_you:harán|haréis}} esto».
es.B: Sirvieron a los ídolos, aunque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} les había dicho: «No {{plural_you:deben|debéis}} hacer esto».
es.R: Adoraron ídolos, aunque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} les había dicho: «No {{plural_you:hagan|hagáis}} esto».

fr.L: Et ils servirent les idoles, au sujet desquelles {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur avait dit : « Vous ne ferez pas cette chose. »
fr.B: Ils avaient servi les idoles, alors que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur avait dit : « Vous ne ferez pas cela. »
fr.R: Ils avaient adoré des idoles, alors que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur avait dit : « Ne faites pas cela. »

sw.L: Nao wakazitumikia sanamu, ambazo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa amewaambia habari zake, "Msilifanye jambo hili."
sw.B: Walizitumikia sanamu, ingawa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa amewaambia, "Msifanye jambo hili."
sw.R: Waliziabudu sanamu, ingawa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa amewaambia, "Msifanye hivyo."

vi.L: Họ phục vụ các thần tượng, là điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán với họ: "Các ngươi không được làm điều này."
vi.B: Họ phục vụ các thần tượng, dù {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán với họ: "Các ngươi không được làm điều này."
vi.R: Họ thờ lạy các thần tượng, dù {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã bảo họ: "Đừng làm điều này."

ko.L: 그리고 그들은 우상들을 섬겼다. 그것들에 대하여 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들에게 "너희는 이 일을 하지 마라" 하고 말씀하셨다.
ko.B: 그들은 우상들을 섬겼다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들에게 "너희는 이런 일을 해서는 안 된다" 하고 말씀하셨는데도 그랬다.
ko.R: 그들은 우상들을 섬겼다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들에게 "이런 일을 하지 마라" 하고 말씀하셨는데도 그랬다.

pt.L: E serviram os ídolos, dos quais {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} lhes tinha dito: "Não farão esta coisa."
pt.B: Serviram os ídolos, embora {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} lhes tivesse dito: "Vocês não devem fazer isso."
pt.R: Adoraram ídolos, mesmo que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} lhes tivesse dito: "Não façam isso."

decisions.choice: the idols: a word of contempt for images of gods
decisions.reason: The word is used mostly in Ezekiel and in Kings of the idols of the nations and of Israel's kings (1 Kings 15:12; 21:26). It may come from a word for round lumps or for dung, and so mocks the idols as worthless things.

decisions.choice: you shall not do this thing: the commandment against idols
decisions.reason: The words sum up the commandments against making and serving images (Exodus 20:4-5; Deuteronomy 4:15-19).

decisions.choice: worshiped
decisions.reason: To serve a god means to worship it; Readable says so.

decisions.choice: {{plural_you:harán|haréis}}
decisions.reason: Yahweh speaks to the whole people, so every plural "you" in this chapter carries the plural_you setting, "ustedes" by default and "vosotros" as the alternative.

decisions.choice: vocês (the LORD to Israel)
decisions.reason: For the whole chapter (verses 12-13, 35-39): the LORD speaks to Israel as a people in the plural, so his words take "vocês", as the Old Testament terms set it; future at Literal, "não devem" at Balanced and the imperative at Readable, the forms of a commandment at each level. "Ídolos" for the scornful word (m1), as 1 Kings 15:12.

source.text: וַיָּ֣עַד יְהוָ֡ה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל וּבִיהוּדָ֡ה בְּיַד֩ כָּל־נְבִיאֵ֨י כָל־חֹזֶ֜ה לֵאמֹ֗ר שֻׁ֝֠בוּ מִדַּרְכֵיכֶ֤ם הָֽרָעִים֙ וְשִׁמְרוּ֙ מִצְוֺתַ֣י חֻקּוֹתַ֔י כְּכָ֨ל־הַתּוֹרָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּ֖יתִי אֶת־אֲבֹֽתֵיכֶ֑ם וַֽאֲשֶׁר֙ שָׁלַ֣חְתִּי אֲלֵיכֶ֔ם בְּיַ֖ד עֲבָדַ֥י הַנְּבִיאִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And warned Yahweh Israel and Judah by [the] hand of every prophet [and] every seer, saying, Turn from your ways the evil, and keep my commandments, my statutes, according to all the law which I commanded your fathers, and which I sent to you by [the] hand of my servants the prophets.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} warned Israel and Judah by the hand of every prophet [and] every seer, saying, "Turn from your evil ways and keep {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} commandments, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} statutes, according to all the law that I commanded your fathers and that I sent to you by the hand of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} slaves the prophets."
en.B: Yet {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} warned Israel and Judah through every prophet and every seer: "Turn back from your evil ways. Keep {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} commandments and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} statutes, in keeping with the whole law that I commanded your ancestors and sent to you through {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servants the prophets."
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} had warned Israel and Judah through every prophet and every seer. He said, "Turn away from the evil things you are doing. Obey {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} commands and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} laws. Follow all the teaching that I gave your ancestors and sent to you through {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servants the prophets."

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} advirtió a Israel y a Judá por mano de todo profeta [y] de todo vidente, diciendo: «{{plural_you:Vuélvanse|Volveos}} de {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} malos caminos y {{plural_you:guarden|guardad}} {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} mandamientos, {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} estatutos, conforme a toda la ley que yo mandé a {{plural_you:sus padres|vuestros padres}} y que les envié por mano de {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} siervos los profetas».
es.B: Sin embargo, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} advirtió a Israel y a Judá por medio de todos los profetas y de todos los videntes: «{{plural_you:Vuélvanse|Volveos}} de {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} malos caminos. {{plural_you:Guarden|Guardad}} {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} mandamientos y {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} estatutos, conforme a toda la ley que mandé a {{plural_you:sus antepasados|vuestros antepasados}} y que les envié por medio de {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} siervos los profetas».
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} les había advertido a Israel y a Judá por medio de todos los profetas y videntes. Les dijo: «{{plural_you:Dejen|Dejad}} de hacer el mal. {{plural_you:Obedezcan|Obedeced}} {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} mandatos y {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} leyes. {{plural_you:Sigan|Seguid}} toda la enseñanza que di a {{plural_you:sus antepasados|vuestros antepasados}} y que les envié por medio de {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} siervos los profetas».

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avertit Israël et Juda par la main de tout prophète [et de] tout voyant, en disant : « Revenez de vos voies mauvaises, et gardez {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} commandements, {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} prescriptions, selon toute la loi que j’ai prescrite à vos pères et que je vous ai envoyée par la main de {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} esclaves les prophètes. »
fr.B: Pourtant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait averti Israël et Juda par tous les prophètes et tous les voyants : « Revenez de vos mauvaises voies. Gardez {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} commandements et {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} prescriptions, conformément à toute la loi que j’ai prescrite à vos ancêtres et que je vous ai transmise par {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} serviteurs les prophètes. »
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait averti Israël et Juda par tous les prophètes et tous les voyants. Il leur avait dit : « Abandonnez le mal que vous faites. Obéissez à {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} commandements et à {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} lois. Suivez tout l’enseignement que j’ai donné à vos ancêtres et que je vous ai transmis par {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} serviteurs les prophètes. »

sw.L: Naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akawaonya Israeli na Yuda kwa mkono wa kila nabii [na] kila mwonaji, akisema, "Geukeni kutoka katika njia zenu mbaya, mzishike amri {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}, masharti {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, sawasawa na sheria yote niliyowaamuru baba zenu, na niliyowapelekea kwa mkono wa watumwa {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} manabii."
sw.B: Lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwaonya Israeli na Yuda kupitia kila nabii na kila mwonaji: "Rudini kutoka katika njia zenu mbaya. Shikeni amri {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} na masharti {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, kwa kufuata sheria yote niliyowaamuru babu zenu na kuwapelekea kupitia watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} manabii."
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa amewaonya Israeli na Yuda kupitia kila nabii na kila mwonaji. Alisema, "Acheni mambo mabaya mnayoyafanya. Tiini amri {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} na sheria {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}. Fuateni mafundisho yote niliyowapa babu zenu na kuwapelekea kupitia watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} manabii."

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã cảnh cáo Y-sơ-ra-ên và Giu-đa bởi tay mọi nhà tiên tri [và] mọi nhà tiên kiến rằng: "Hãy quay khỏi các đường lối gian ác của các ngươi và giữ các điều răn của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, các luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, theo toàn bộ luật pháp mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã truyền cho tổ phụ các ngươi và đã gửi đến các ngươi bởi tay các đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là các nhà tiên tri."
vi.B: Thế mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã cảnh cáo Y-sơ-ra-ên và Giu-đa qua mọi nhà tiên tri và mọi nhà tiên kiến: "Hãy từ bỏ các đường lối gian ác của các ngươi. Hãy giữ các điều răn và luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, theo đúng toàn bộ luật pháp mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã truyền cho tổ tiên các ngươi và đã gửi đến các ngươi qua các đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là các nhà tiên tri."
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã cảnh cáo Y-sơ-ra-ên và Giu-đa qua mọi nhà tiên tri và mọi nhà tiên kiến. Ngài phán: "Hãy từ bỏ những việc ác các ngươi đang làm. Hãy vâng giữ các mệnh lệnh và luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Hãy làm theo mọi lời dạy mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã ban cho tổ tiên các ngươi và đã gửi đến các ngươi qua các đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là các nhà tiên tri."

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 모든 예언자와 모든 선견자의 손으로 이스라엘과 유다에게 경고하여 말씀하셨다. "너희는 너희의 악한 길에서 돌이키고, 내가 너희 조상들에게 명령하고 내 종 예언자들의 손으로 너희에게 보낸 모든 율법대로 내 계명과 내 규례를 지켜라."
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 모든 예언자와 모든 선견자를 통하여 이스라엘과 유다에게 경고하셨다. "너희의 악한 길에서 돌이켜라. 내가 너희 조상들에게 명령하고 내 종 예언자들을 통하여 너희에게 보낸 모든 율법대로 내 계명과 내 규례를 지켜라."
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 모든 예언자와 모든 선견자를 통하여 이스라엘과 유다에게 경고하셨다. "너희가 하고 있는 악한 일에서 돌이켜라. 내 명령과 내 법을 지켜라. 내가 너희 조상들에게 주고, 내 종 예언자들을 통하여 너희에게 보낸 모든 가르침을 따라라."

pt.L: E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} advertiu Israel e Judá pela mão de todo profeta [e] todo vidente, dizendo: "Voltem-se dos seus maus caminhos e guardem os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} mandamentos, os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} estatutos, conforme toda a lei que ordenei aos pais de vocês e que enviei a vocês pela mão dos {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} escravos, os profetas."
pt.B: Mesmo assim, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} advertiu Israel e Judá por meio de todos os profetas e videntes: "Deixem os seus maus caminhos. Guardem os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} mandamentos e os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} estatutos, de acordo com toda a lei que ordenei aos antepassados de vocês e que lhes enviei por meio dos {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} servos, os profetas."
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} tinha advertido Israel e Judá por meio de todos os profetas e videntes. Ele disse: "Parem de fazer as coisas más que vocês fazem. Obedeçam aos {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} mandamentos e às {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} leis. Sigam todo o ensino que eu dei aos antepassados de vocês e que enviei a vocês por meio dos {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} servos, os profetas."

decisions.choice: every prophet: reading the form noted in the margin of the Hebrew
decisions.reason: The written Hebrew text has "his prophet", which does not fit the sentence. The Masoretes' marginal reading, followed here, gives "prophets of", so that the phrase means "all the prophets, every seer": every prophet Yahweh sent.

decisions.choice: warned: solemnly testified to them
decisions.reason: The verb means to call witnesses or to testify against someone, and so to warn with full solemnity (Deuteronomy 8:19; 30:19). It is the root of the word "testimonies" in verse 15: Yahweh's warnings were themselves part of his covenant.

decisions.choice: seer: another name for a prophet
decisions.reason: A seer is one who sees what Yahweh shows him in visions. The word is used alongside "prophet" for the same people (1 Samuel 9:9; 2 Samuel 24:11).

decisions.choice: turn from your evil ways and keep my commandments: the prophets' call
decisions.reason: This sums up the message of the prophets sent to Israel and Judah, from Ahijah and Elijah to Amos and Hosea: repent and return to the covenant. The law they called people back to was the one given to their ancestors at Sinai.

decisions.choice: commandments, statutes, law (Literal, Balanced); commands, laws, teaching (Readable)
decisions.reason: The wording settled for these terms (1 Kings 2:3).

decisions.choice: slaves (Literal); servants (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The rule for this word: "slave" at Literal, "servant" at Balanced and Readable, as with "my servant David". The prophets belong wholly to Yahweh and act for him.

decisions.choice: "mandamientos, estatutos, ley" (L, B); "mandatos, leyes, enseñanza" (R)
decisions.reason: One word per level for each of these terms through Kings, following the English levels; Readable says "enseñanza" for the law as the published Spanish does.

decisions.choice: "siervos"
decisions.reason: As the Psalms terms note sets for Spanish, God's servants the prophets are "siervos" at every level, Literal included.

decisions.choice: "commandements, prescriptions, loi" (L, B); "commandements, lois, enseignement" (R)
decisions.reason: The covenant words as the French Pentateuch note sets them; Readable loosens them as the English does.

decisions.choice: amri, masharti, sheria (Literal, Balanced); amri, sheria, mafundisho (Readable)
decisions.reason: The law words of this chapter: "amri" for commandments, "masharti" for statutes where they stand beside commandments, "sheria" for the law (*torah*), which Readable calls "mafundisho", teaching, as the English does.

decisions.choice: watumwa (Literal); watumishi (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As for *ʿeved* elsewhere; God's free possessive "wangu" takes the deity pronoun span.

decisions.choice: điều răn, luật lệ, luật pháp (L, B); mệnh lệnh, luật lệ, lời dạy (R)
decisions.reason: Each word for God's law keeps one Vietnamese word through these chapters, following the English settlement; Readable uses everyday words.

decisions.choice: nô lệ (L); đầy tớ (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in 14:25, Literal keeps "slave" for the prophets as God's servants, and the other levels say "đầy tớ".

decisions.choice: "내 종 예언자들" at every level
decisions.reason: As 14:25, "종" for God's servants at every level; God speaks in the plain style with "나" and "너희".

decisions.choice: vidente; mandamentos, estatutos, lei (L, B), mandamentos, leis, ensino (R); escravos (L), servos (B, R)
decisions.reason: The seer (m3) is "vidente", the word of 1 Samuel 9:9 in Portuguese. The terms for the LORD's commands keep the words 1 Kings 2:3 set at each level, as the English follows that verse; "escravos" at Literal and "servos" at Balanced and Readable, as the Old Testament terms set it for the LORD's servants.

source.text: וְלֹ֖א שָׁמֵ֑עוּ וַיַּקְשׁ֤וּ אֶת־עָרְפָּם֙ כְּעֹ֣רֶף אֲבוֹתָ֔ם אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹ֣א הֶאֱמִ֔ינוּ בַּֽיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And not they listened, and stiffened their neck like [the] neck of their fathers, who not trusted in Yahweh their God.

en.L: And they did not listen, and they stiffened their neck like the neck of their fathers, who did not trust in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God.
en.B: But they would not listen. They stiffened their necks as their ancestors had done, who did not trust in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God.
en.R: But they would not listen. They were stubborn, just like their ancestors, who did not trust {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God.

es.L: Pero no escucharon, sino que endurecieron su cerviz como la cerviz de sus padres, que no confiaron en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios.
es.B: Pero no quisieron escuchar. Endurecieron su cerviz como lo habían hecho sus antepasados, que no confiaron en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios.
es.R: Pero no quisieron escuchar. Fueron tercos, igual que sus antepasados, que no confiaron en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios.

fr.L: Mais ils n’écoutèrent pas, et ils raidirent leur nuque comme la nuque de leurs pères, qui ne s’étaient pas fiés à {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur Dieu.
