fr.B: Mais ils n’avaient pas voulu écouter. Ils avaient raidi la nuque comme leurs ancêtres, qui n’avaient pas fait confiance à {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur Dieu.
fr.R: Mais ils n’ont pas voulu écouter. Ils se sont entêtés comme leurs ancêtres, qui n’avaient pas fait confiance à {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur Dieu.

sw.L: Wala hawakusikia, bali wakafanya shingo zao kuwa ngumu kama shingo za baba zao, ambao hawakumwamini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao.
sw.B: Lakini hawakutaka kusikiliza. Walifanya shingo zao kuwa ngumu kama babu zao walivyofanya, ambao hawakumtumaini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao.
sw.R: Lakini hawakutaka kusikiliza. Walikuwa wakaidi kama babu zao, ambao hawakumtumaini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao.

vi.L: Nhưng họ không nghe, mà làm cứng cổ mình như cổ của tổ phụ họ, là những người không tin cậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ.
vi.B: Nhưng họ không chịu nghe. Họ cứng cổ như tổ tiên họ, là những người đã không tin cậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ.
vi.R: Nhưng họ không chịu nghe. Họ ương ngạnh giống như tổ tiên họ, là những người đã không tin cậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ.

ko.L: 그러나 그들은 듣지 않고, 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 믿지 않은 그들의 조상들의 목처럼 그들의 목을 곧게 했다.
ko.B: 그러나 그들은 듣지 않았다. 그들은 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 믿지 않은 조상들처럼 목을 곧게 했다.
ko.R: 그러나 그들은 듣지 않았다. 그들은 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 믿지 않은 조상들처럼 고집을 부렸다.

pt.L: Mas não ouviram, e endureceram a sua cerviz como a cerviz dos seus pais, que não confiaram {{divine_name:no SENHOR|em Javé}}, o seu Deus.
pt.B: Mas eles não quiseram ouvir. Endureceram a cerviz, como os seus antepassados, que não confiaram {{divine_name:no SENHOR|em Javé}}, o seu Deus.
pt.R: Mas eles não quiseram ouvir. Foram teimosos, como os seus antepassados, que não confiaram {{divine_name:no SENHOR|em Javé}}, o seu Deus.

decisions.choice: stiffened their neck: refused to obey
decisions.reason: The picture is of an ox that stiffens its neck against the yoke and will not be led. It is said of Israel in the wilderness (Exodus 32:9; Deuteronomy 9:6; 10:16; 31:27), and their descendants are like them.

decisions.choice: who did not trust in Yahweh: the wilderness generation
decisions.reason: The same words are used of the generation that refused to enter the land (Numbers 14:11; Deuteronomy 1:32; 9:23). To trust in Yahweh is to rely on him and take him at his word.

decisions.choice: were stubborn
decisions.reason: Readable explains the idiom (m1), as in Deuteronomy 9:6. Literal and Balanced keep the picture.

decisions.choice: endureceram a cerviz (L, B); foram teimosos (R); não confiaram no SENHOR
decisions.reason: The picture (m1) takes the words of Exodus 32:9 and Deuteronomy 10:16 in Portuguese, "cerviz", the old word for the back of the neck that Portuguese keeps for this idiom; Literal and Balanced keep the picture, as the English does, and Readable says "teimosos", the word Deuteronomy 10:16 uses at Balanced and Readable. "Não confiaram no SENHOR" is the wording of Deuteronomy 1:32 (m2).

source.text: וַיִּמְאֲס֣וּ אֶת־חֻקָּ֗יו וְאֶת־בְּרִיתוֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר כָּרַ֣ת אֶת־אֲבוֹתָ֔ם וְאֵת֙ עֵֽדְוֺתָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֵעִ֖יד בָּ֑ם וַיֵּ֨לְכ֜וּאַחֲרֵ֤י הַהֶ֨בֶל֙ וַיֶּהְבָּ֔לוּ וְאַחֲרֵ֤י הַגּוֹיִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר סְבִֽיבֹתָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ אֹתָ֔ם לְבִלְתִּ֖י עֲשׂ֥וֹת כָּהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And they rejected his statutes and his covenant which he made with their fathers, and his testimonies which he testified against them; and they walked after the vanity and became vain, and after the nations which [were] around them, which commanded Yahweh them not to do like them.

en.L: And they rejected {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} statutes and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} covenant that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made with their fathers, and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} testimonies with which {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} warned them; and they went after worthless idols and became worthless, and after the nations that [were] around them, concerning whom {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded them not to do as they [did].
en.B: They rejected {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} statutes, the covenant {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had made with their ancestors, and the decrees by which {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had warned them. They went after worthless idols and became worthless themselves. They followed the nations around them, although {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded them not to do as those nations did.
en.R: They rejected {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} laws and the covenant {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had made with their ancestors. They ignored the instructions {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had given to warn them. They followed useless idols and became useless themselves. They copied the nations around them, even though {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded them not to live like those nations.

es.L: Y rechazaron {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} estatutos y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pacto que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} hizo con sus padres, y {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} testimonios con que les advirtió; y anduvieron tras ídolos vanos y se volvieron vanos, y tras las naciones que [estaban] alrededor de ellos, acerca de las cuales {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} les había mandado que no hicieran como ellas.
es.B: Rechazaron {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} estatutos, el pacto que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} había hecho con sus antepasados y los decretos con que les había advertido. Se fueron tras ídolos vanos y ellos mismos se volvieron vanos. Siguieron a las naciones que los rodeaban, aunque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} les había mandado que no hicieran como ellas.
es.R: Rechazaron {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} leyes y el pacto que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} había hecho con sus antepasados. No hicieron caso de las instrucciones que les había dado para advertirles. Siguieron a ídolos inútiles y se volvieron inútiles ellos mismos. Imitaron a las naciones que los rodeaban, aunque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} les había mandado que no vivieran como ellas.

fr.L: Et ils rejetèrent {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} prescriptions et {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} alliance qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait conclue avec leurs pères, et {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} témoignages par lesquels {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les avait avertis ; et ils allèrent après la vanité et devinrent vains, et après les nations qui [étaient] autour d’eux, au sujet desquelles {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur avait ordonné de ne pas faire comme elles.
fr.B: Ils avaient rejeté {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} prescriptions, l’alliance qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait conclue avec leurs ancêtres et les avertissements solennels qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur avait adressés. Ils avaient couru après des idoles sans valeur et étaient devenus eux-mêmes sans valeur. Ils avaient suivi les nations qui les entouraient, alors que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur avait ordonné de ne pas faire comme elles.
fr.R: Ils avaient rejeté {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} lois et l’alliance qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait faite avec leurs ancêtres. Ils n’avaient pas tenu compte des avertissements qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur avait donnés. Ils avaient suivi des idoles qui ne valent rien, et ils étaient devenus eux-mêmes des gens qui ne valent rien. Ils avaient imité les peuples qui les entouraient, alors que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur avait ordonné de ne pas vivre comme eux.

sw.L: Nao wakazikataa amri {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} na agano {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} alilofanya na baba zao, na shuhuda {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} alizowashuhudia; wakafuata ubatili, wakawa batili, na [wakafuata] mataifa yaliyowazunguka, ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa amewaamuru wasifanye kama wao.
sw.B: Walizikataa amri {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}, na agano alilokuwa amefanya na babu zao, na maagizo aliyowaonya kwayo. Walifuata sanamu zisizofaa kitu, nao wenyewe wakawa wasiofaa kitu. Waliyafuata mataifa yaliyowazunguka, ingawa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa amewaamuru wasifanye kama mataifa hayo.
sw.R: Walizikataa sheria {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} na agano alilokuwa amefanya na babu zao. Hawakujali maagizo aliyowapa ili kuwaonya. Walifuata sanamu zisizofaa kitu, nao wenyewe wakawa watu wasiofaa kitu. Waliiga mataifa yaliyowazunguka, ingawa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa amewaamuru wasiishi kama mataifa hayo.

vi.L: Họ khước từ các luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và giao ước {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã lập với tổ phụ họ, cùng các chứng ước mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã dùng để cảnh cáo họ; họ đi theo sự hư không và trở nên hư không, và theo các dân tộc chung quanh họ, là những dân mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã truyền cho họ đừng làm như chúng.
vi.B: Họ khước từ luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, giao ước {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã lập với tổ tiên họ, và các huấn lệnh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã dùng để cảnh cáo họ. Họ đi theo các thần tượng hư không và chính họ trở nên hư không. Họ theo các dân tộc chung quanh, dù {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã truyền cho họ đừng làm như các dân ấy.
vi.R: Họ khước từ luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và giao ước {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã lập với tổ tiên họ. Họ bỏ ngoài tai những lời chỉ dẫn {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã ban để cảnh cáo họ. Họ theo các thần tượng vô ích và chính họ trở nên vô ích. Họ bắt chước các dân tộc chung quanh, dù {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã truyền cho họ đừng sống như các dân ấy.

ko.L: 그리고 그들은 그분의 규례와 그분께서 그들의 조상들과 맺으신 그분의 언약과 그분께서 그들에게 경고하신 그분의 증거들을 거부했다. 그리고 그들은 헛된 것을 따라가 헛되게 되었고, 그들 주위에 있는 민족들을 따라갔다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들에게 그 민족들처럼 하지 말라고 명령하셨던 민족들이었다.
ko.B: 그들은 그분의 규례와 그분께서 그들의 조상들과 맺으신 언약과, 그분께서 그들에게 경고하신 증거의 말씀을 거부했다. 그들은 헛된 우상을 따라가다가 자기들도 헛되게 되었다. 그들은 주위의 민족들을 따랐다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그 민족들처럼 하지 말라고 명령하셨는데도 그랬다.
ko.R: 그들은 그분의 법과 그분께서 그들의 조상들과 맺으신 언약을 거부했다. 그분께서 그들에게 경고하려고 주신 가르침도 무시했다. 그들은 쓸모없는 우상을 따라가다가 자기들도 쓸모없게 되었다. 그들은 주위의 민족들을 흉내 냈다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그 민족들처럼 살지 말라고 명령하셨는데도 그랬다.

pt.L: E rejeitaram os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} estatutos e a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} aliança que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fez com os seus pais, e os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} testemunhos com que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os advertiu; e foram atrás de ídolos inúteis e se tornaram inúteis, e atrás das nações que [estavam] ao redor deles, a respeito das quais {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} lhes tinha ordenado que não fizessem como elas.
pt.B: Rejeitaram os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} estatutos, a aliança que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} tinha feito com os antepassados deles e os decretos com que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os tinha advertido. Foram atrás de ídolos inúteis e se tornaram inúteis eles mesmos. Seguiram as nações ao redor deles, embora {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} lhes tivesse ordenado que não fizessem como aquelas nações.
pt.R: Rejeitaram as {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} leis e a aliança que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} tinha feito com os antepassados deles. Não deram atenção às instruções que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes tinha dado para adverti-los. Seguiram ídolos sem valor e eles mesmos ficaram sem valor. Imitaram as nações ao redor deles, mesmo que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} lhes tivesse ordenado que não vivessem como aquelas nações.

decisions.choice: the vanity: worthless idols
decisions.reason: The word *hevel* means a breath or vapor, something empty and passing. Used of gods it names idols as nothing at all (Deuteronomy 32:21; 1 Kings 16:13).

decisions.choice: went after worthless idols and became worthless: people become like what they worship
decisions.reason: The noun and the verb come from the same word: they followed *hevel* and became *hevel*. Jeremiah 2:5 says the same of Judah, and Psalm 115:8 says that those who make idols become like them.

decisions.choice: his testimonies with which he warned them: the covenant's solemn terms
decisions.reason: "Testimonies" and "warned" share a root (verse 13). The covenant terms were themselves a warning, declared before witnesses, of what would follow if the covenant was broken (Deuteronomy 31:26-29).

decisions.choice: they rejected his statutes and his covenant
decisions.reason: Israel's rejection of Yahweh comes first; his rejection of them follows (verse 20). The same verb is used both times.

decisions.choice: worthless idols ... became worthless (Literal, Balanced); useless idols ... became useless (Readable)
decisions.reason: The wording of 1 Kings 16:13. Each level repeats one word so the play between noun and verb is kept (m2).

decisions.choice: statutes, testimonies (Literal); statutes, decrees (Balanced); laws, instructions (Readable)
decisions.reason: The settled wording for these terms (1 Kings 2:3).

decisions.choice: "ídolos vanos ... se volvieron vanos" (L, B); "ídolos inútiles ... se volvieron inútiles" (R)
decisions.reason: Each level repeats one word so the play between noun and verb is kept: people become like what they worship (m2).

decisions.choice: "la vanité ... devinrent vains" (L); "idoles sans valeur ... sans valeur" (B); "idoles qui ne valent rien ... qui ne valent rien" (R)
decisions.reason: The play on the word for vapor (m1, m2) is kept by repeating the same French word in both halves at each level.

decisions.choice: ubatili ... wakawa batili (Literal); sanamu zisizofaa kitu ... wakawa wasiofaa kitu (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew plays on one word: they followed "vanity" and became "vain" (meaning decision m2). Each level keeps the repeated word, so the reader hears that people become like what they worship.

decisions.choice: sự hư không ... trở nên hư không (L); thần tượng hư không ... trở nên hư không (B); vô ích ... vô ích (R)
decisions.reason: Each level repeats one word, so that the play between the idols and their worshipers is heard (m2).

decisions.choice: "헛된 것 ... 헛되게 되었다" (L), "헛된 우상 ... 헛되게 되었다" (B), "쓸모없는 우상 ... 쓸모없게 되었다" (R)
decisions.reason: Korean repeats one word for the idols and for the people who became like them, keeping the play of the Hebrew (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: ídolos inúteis ... se tornaram inúteis (L, B); ídolos sem valor ... ficaram sem valor (R); testemunhos (L), decretos (B), instruções (R)
decisions.reason: Each level repeats one word for the noun and the verb (m2), in the words 1 Kings 16:13 gives the worthless idols in Portuguese: "inúteis" at Literal and Balanced, "sem valor" at Readable. The testimonies (m3) keep the words 1 Kings 2:3 sets at each level. Balanced and Readable say "os antepassados deles", since "seus" beside the LORD's statutes could be read as his.

source.text: וַיַּעַזְב֗וּ אֶת־כָּל־מִצְוֺת֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֔ם וַיַּעֲשׂ֥וּ לָהֶ֛ם מַסֵּכָ֖ה שְׁנֵ֣י עֲגָלִ֑ים וַיַּעֲשׂ֣וּ אֲשֵׁירָ֗ה וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲווּ֙ לְכָל־צְבָ֣א הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וַיַּעַבְד֖וּ אֶת־הַבָּֽעַל׃

records.literal_gloss: And they forsook all [the] commandments of Yahweh their God, and made for themselves a cast image, two calves, and made an Asherah pole, and bowed down to all [the] host of the heavens, and served the Baal.

en.L: And they forsook all the commandments of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God, and they made for themselves a cast image, two calves, and they made an Asherah pole, and they bowed down to all the host of the heavens, and they served the Baal.
en.B: They abandoned every commandment of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God and made themselves cast images, two calves. They made an Asherah pole, bowed down to all the host of heaven, and served Baal.
en.R: They turned away from all the commands of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God. They made two metal statues of calves for themselves. They set up a pole used to worship Asherah. They bowed down to the sun, moon and stars, and they worshiped the god Baal.

es.L: Y abandonaron todos los mandamientos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} su Dios, y se hicieron una imagen fundida, dos becerros, e hicieron un poste de Aserá, y se postraron ante todo el ejército de los cielos, y sirvieron a Baal.
es.B: Abandonaron todos los mandamientos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} su Dios y se hicieron imágenes fundidas, dos becerros. Hicieron un poste de Aserá, se postraron ante todo el ejército de los cielos y sirvieron a Baal.
es.R: Se apartaron de todos los mandatos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} su Dios. Se hicieron dos estatuas de becerros de metal. Levantaron un poste para adorar a Aserá. Se inclinaron ante el sol, la luna y las estrellas, y adoraron al dios Baal.

fr.L: Et ils abandonnèrent tous les commandements {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} leur Dieu, et ils se firent une image en métal fondu, deux veaux, et ils firent un poteau d’Ashéra, et ils se prosternèrent devant toute l’armée des cieux, et ils servirent le Baal.
fr.B: Ils avaient abandonné tous les commandements {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} leur Dieu et s’étaient fait des images en métal fondu, deux veaux. Ils avaient fait un poteau d’Ashéra, s’étaient prosternés devant toute l’armée des cieux et avaient servi Baal.
fr.R: Ils s’étaient détournés de tous les commandements {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} leur Dieu. Ils s’étaient fabriqué deux statues de veaux en métal. Ils avaient installé un poteau sacré de la déesse Ashéra. Ils s’étaient mis à genoux devant le soleil, la lune et les étoiles, et ils avaient adoré le dieu Baal.

sw.L: Nao wakaziacha amri zote za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao, wakajifanyia sanamu ya kusubu, ndama wawili, wakafanya mti wa Ashera, wakalisujudia jeshi lote la mbinguni, wakamtumikia Baali.
sw.B: Waliziacha amri zote za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao, wakajifanyia sanamu za kusubu, ndama wawili. Wakafanya mti wa Ashera, wakalisujudia jeshi lote la mbinguni, wakamtumikia Baali.
sw.R: Waliziacha amri zote za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao. Walijitengenezea sanamu mbili za chuma za ndama. Wakasimamisha nguzo ya kumwabudu mungu wa kike Ashera. Waliyasujudia jua, mwezi na nyota, nao wakamwabudu mungu Baali.

vi.L: Họ bỏ mọi điều răn của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ, và làm cho mình một tượng đúc, hai con bò con, và làm một trụ A-sê-ra, cúi lạy cả cơ binh trên trời và phục vụ Ba-anh.
vi.B: Họ chối bỏ mọi điều răn của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ và làm cho mình các tượng đúc, là hai con bò con. Họ làm một trụ A-sê-ra, cúi lạy cả cơ binh trên trời và phục vụ Ba-anh.
vi.R: Họ quay lưng với mọi mệnh lệnh của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ. Họ đúc cho mình hai tượng bò con bằng kim loại. Họ dựng một trụ dùng để thờ nữ thần A-sê-ra. Họ cúi lạy mặt trời, mặt trăng và các ngôi sao, và thờ thần Ba-anh.

ko.L: 그리고 그들은 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 모든 계명을 버리고, 자기들을 위해 부어 만든 형상, 곧 송아지 두 개를 만들고, 아세라 목상을 만들고, 하늘의 모든 군대에게 절하고, 바알을 섬겼다.
ko.B: 그들은 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 모든 계명을 저버리고, 쇠붙이를 부어 송아지 형상 둘을 만들었다. 그들은 아세라 목상을 만들고, 하늘의 모든 별에게 절하고, 바알을 섬겼다.
ko.R: 그들은 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 모든 명령을 저버렸다. 그들은 쇠붙이로 송아지 상 두 개를 만들었다. 그들은 아세라를 섬기는 데 쓰는 목상을 세웠다. 그들은 해와 달과 별들에게 절했고, 바알 신을 섬겼다.

pt.L: E abandonaram todos os mandamentos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o seu Deus, e fizeram para si uma imagem de metal fundido, dois bezerros, e fizeram um poste de Aserá, e se prostraram diante de todo o exército dos céus, e serviram o Baal.
pt.B: Abandonaram todos os mandamentos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o seu Deus, e fizeram para si imagens de metal fundido, dois bezerros. Fizeram um poste de Aserá, prostraram-se diante de todo o exército do céu e serviram Baal.
pt.R: Deixaram de lado todos os mandamentos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o seu Deus. Fizeram para si duas estátuas de bezerro, de metal. Levantaram um poste usado para adorar a deusa Aserá. Curvaram-se diante do sol, da lua e das estrelas e adoraram o deus Baal.

decisions.choice: a cast image, two calves: Jeroboam's calves at Bethel and Dan
decisions.reason: Jeroboam set up two golden calves, one at Bethel and one at Dan (1 Kings 12:28-29). The words recall the cast calf Israel made at Sinai (Exodus 32:4, 8): the northern kingdom began by repeating that sin.

decisions.choice: the host of the heavens: the sun, moon and stars worshiped as gods
decisions.reason: The phrase can mean Yahweh's heavenly court (1 Kings 22:19), but here it is the heavenly bodies, which the nations worshiped and the law forbade Israel to worship (Deuteronomy 4:19; 17:3). This worship grew under Assyrian influence (21:3-5; 23:4-5).

decisions.choice: an Asherah pole; the Baal
decisions.reason: Ahab made an Asherah pole and served Baal in Samaria (1 Kings 16:31-33). Jehu destroyed Baal's temple there (10:27-28), but the writer counts the whole history together.

decisions.choice: the sun, moon and stars
decisions.reason: Readable names what "the host of heaven" means here (m2), as in Deuteronomy 4:19.

decisions.choice: cast images (Balanced); metal statues (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew singular stands for the two calves together; Balanced uses the plural so the list reads naturally.

decisions.choice: "el sol, la luna y las estrellas"
decisions.reason: Readable names what "the host of heaven" means here (m2), as the English does.

decisions.choice: "l'armée des cieux"
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the Hebrew picture of the heavenly army; Readable names the sun, moon and stars, as the English does (m2).

decisions.choice: jua, mwezi na nyota
decisions.reason: Readable names what "the host of heaven" was (meaning decision m2), as the English does.

decisions.choice: "하늘의 모든 군대" (L); "하늘의 모든 별" (B); "해와 달과 별들" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture; Balanced and Readable say what was worshiped, the heavenly bodies.

decisions.choice: imagem de metal fundido (L), imagens de metal fundido (B), estátuas ... de metal (R); o exército dos céus (L), o exército do céu (B), o sol, da lua e das estrelas (R)
decisions.reason: The cast image (m1) takes the words Exodus 32:4 gives the calf at Sinai in Portuguese, "de metal fundido", so that the echo is heard. The host of heaven (m2) is worded as Deuteronomy 4:19 and 17:3 have it in Portuguese; Readable names the sun, moon and stars, as the English does. "O Baal" at Literal keeps the Hebrew article, as 1 Kings 16:31.

source.text: וַֽ֠יַּעֲבִירוּ אֶת־בְּנֵיהֶ֤ם וְאֶת־בְּנֽוֹתֵיהֶם֙ בָּאֵ֔שׁ וַיִּקְסְמ֥וּ קְסָמִ֖ים וַיְנַחֵ֑שׁוּ וַיִּֽתְמַכְּר֗וּ לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת הָרַ֛ע בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לְהַכְעִיסֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And they made pass their sons and their daughters in the fire, and divined divinations and practiced omens, and sold themselves to do the evil in [the] eyes of Yahweh, to provoke him.

en.L: And they made their sons and their daughters pass through the fire, and they practiced divination and read omens, and they sold themselves to do the evil in [the] eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, to provoke {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to anger.
en.B: They made their sons and daughters pass through the fire, practiced divination and read omens, and sold themselves to do what was evil in the sight of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, provoking {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to anger.
en.R: They burned their sons and daughters in the fire as sacrifices. They used magic to learn secret things and read signs to know the future. They gave themselves completely to doing what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said was evil, and this made {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} angry.

es.L: E hicieron pasar a sus hijos y a sus hijas por el fuego, y practicaron adivinaciones y agüeros, y se vendieron para hacer lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, para provocar{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} a ira.
es.B: Hicieron pasar a sus hijos y a sus hijas por el fuego, practicaron la adivinación y leyeron presagios, y se vendieron para hacer lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, provocándo{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} a ira.
es.R: Quemaron a sus hijos y a sus hijas en el fuego como sacrificios. Usaron la magia para descubrir cosas secretas y leyeron señales para conocer el futuro. Se entregaron por completo a hacer lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} reprueba, y esto {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} hizo enojar.

fr.L: Et ils firent passer leurs fils et leurs filles par le feu, et ils pratiquèrent la divination et lurent les présages, et ils se vendirent pour faire ce qui est mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, pour {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}irriter.
fr.B: Ils avaient fait passer leurs fils et leurs filles par le feu, pratiqué la divination et cherché des présages, et ils s’étaient vendus pour faire ce qui est mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, provoquant ainsi {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère.
fr.R: Ils avaient brûlé leurs fils et leurs filles dans le feu, en sacrifice. Ils avaient utilisé la magie pour découvrir des secrets, et ils avaient cherché des signes pour connaître l’avenir. Ils s’étaient donnés complètement à faire ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} déclare mauvais, et cela {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a mis en colère.

sw.L: Nao wakawapitisha wana wao na binti zao motoni, wakatumia uganga na kutazama ishara, wakajiuza kufanya maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ili kumkasirisha.
sw.B: Waliwapitisha wana wao na binti zao motoni, wakatumia uganga na kutazama ishara, wakajiuza kufanya maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, wakimkasirisha.
sw.R: Waliwachoma wana wao na binti zao motoni kuwa dhabihu. Walitumia uchawi ili kujua mambo ya siri, na kutazama ishara ili kujua yatakayotokea. Walijitoa kabisa kufanya yale {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyoyaona kuwa mabaya, na jambo hilo likamkasirisha.

vi.L: Họ cho con trai và con gái mình đi qua lửa, làm bói toán và xem điềm, bán mình để làm điều ác trước mắt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, chọc giận {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Họ cho con trai con gái mình đi qua lửa, làm bói toán và xem điềm, và bán mình để làm điều ác trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, chọc giận {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Họ thiêu con trai con gái mình trong lửa để làm sinh tế. Họ dùng bùa phép để dò biết những điều bí ẩn và xem điềm để biết tương lai. Họ dốc lòng làm những điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho là ác, và điều này khiến {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nổi giận.

ko.L: 그리고 그들은 그들의 아들들과 그들의 딸들을 불 가운데로 지나가게 하고, 점을 치고 징조를 읽었다. 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 눈에 악한 일을 하려고 자기 자신을 팔아 그분을 노엽게 했다.
ko.B: 그들은 자기 아들딸들을 불 가운데로 지나가게 하고, 점을 치고 징조를 살폈다. 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 보시기에 악한 일을 하려고 자기 자신을 팔아 그분의 진노를 일으켰다.
ko.R: 그들은 자기 아들딸들을 불에 태워 제물로 바쳤다. 그들은 감추어진 일을 알아내려고 점을 쳤고, 앞날을 알려고 징조를 살폈다. 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 악하다고 하신 일에 자기 자신을 온통 내맡겼고, 그래서 그분을 화나시게 했다.

pt.L: E fizeram os seus filhos e as suas filhas passar pelo fogo, e praticaram adivinhação e interpretaram presságios, e se venderam para fazer o mal aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, para {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} provocar à ira.
pt.B: Fizeram os seus filhos e as suas filhas passar pelo fogo, praticaram adivinhação e interpretaram presságios, e se venderam para fazer o que era mau aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, provocando-{{deity_pronoun:o|O}} à ira.
pt.R: Queimaram os seus filhos e as suas filhas no fogo como sacrifício. Usaram magia para descobrir coisas escondidas e leram sinais para saber o futuro. Entregaram-se completamente a fazer o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} considerava mau, e isso {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} deixou irado.

decisions.choice: made their sons and daughters pass through the fire: child sacrifice
decisions.reason: The law forbids it as the practice of the nations (Leviticus 18:21; Deuteronomy 18:10). Ahaz of Judah had done it (16:3), and Jeremiah 7:31 says plainly that children were burned. Some think the phrase could also cover a rite of passing children through fire to dedicate them, but in Kings it names the worst of the nations' practices.

decisions.choice: practiced divination and read omens: seeking hidden knowledge
decisions.reason: Two kinds of fortune-telling forbidden together in Deuteronomy 18:10: the first, consulting spirits or casting lots for an answer; the second, reading signs and omens.

decisions.choice: sold themselves: gave themselves over wholly
decisions.reason: Like someone who sells himself as a slave, they handed themselves over to doing evil. The same is said of Ahab (1 Kings 21:20, 25).

decisions.choice: burned ... as sacrifices; used magic to learn secret things; read signs to know the future
decisions.reason: Readable explains these practices in plain words, as in Deuteronomy 18:10.

decisions.choice: the verdict formula
decisions.reason: Worded as in verse 2.

decisions.choice: "quemaron ... como sacrificios"; "usaron la magia para descubrir cosas secretas"; "leyeron señales para conocer el futuro"
decisions.reason: Readable explains these practices in plain words, as the English does and as the published Spanish Genesis 44 does for divination.

decisions.choice: uganga; kutazama ishara
decisions.reason: The two practices of seeking hidden knowledge (meaning decision m2): "uganga" for divination and "kutazama ishara" for reading omens.

decisions.choice: passar pelo fogo; praticaram adivinhação e interpretaram presságios (L, B); usaram magia ... leram sinais (R); se venderam (L, B), entregaram-se completamente (R)
decisions.reason: The rite and the two kinds of fortune-telling (m1, m2) keep, level by level, the words of Deuteronomy 18:10 in Portuguese, as 16:3 does. "Se venderam" at Literal and Balanced is the wording 1 Kings 21:20 gives Ahab in Portuguese (m3); Readable says "se entregaram", as it does there.

source.text: וַיִּתְאַנַּ֨ף יְהוָ֤ה מְאֹד֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיְסִרֵ֖ם מֵעַ֣ל פָּנָ֑יו לֹ֣א נִשְׁאַ֔ר רַ֛ק שֵׁ֥בֶט יְהוּדָ֖ה לְבַדּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And was angry Yahweh very with Israel, and removed them from before his face; not was left [any] only [the] tribe of Judah by itself.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} was very angry with Israel, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} removed them from before {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} face; none was left except the tribe of Judah alone.
en.B: So {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} was very angry with Israel and removed them from {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} presence. None was left but the tribe of Judah alone.
en.R: So {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} was very angry with Israel, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} sent them away from {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} presence. Only the tribe of Judah was left.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se enojó mucho con Israel, y los quitó de delante de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} rostro; no quedó [nadie] sino solo la tribu de Judá.
es.B: Por eso {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se enojó mucho con Israel y los quitó de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} presencia. No quedó nadie sino solo la tribu de Judá.
es.R: Por eso {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se enojó mucho con Israel, y los echó de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} presencia. Solo quedó la tribu de Judá.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} fut très irrité contre Israël, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les ôta de devant {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} face ; il ne resta que la tribu de Juda seule.
fr.B: Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} fut très irrité contre Israël et les rejeta loin de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} présence. Il ne resta que la seule tribu de Juda.
fr.R: Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} s’est mis très en colère contre Israël, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a renvoyé les Israélites loin de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Seule la tribu de Juda est restée.

sw.L: Naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akawakasirikia Israeli sana, akawaondoa mbele ya uso {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}; hakubaki [hata mmoja] ila kabila la Yuda peke yake.
sw.B: Basi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwakasirikia Israeli sana, akawaondoa mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. Hakuna aliyebaki ila kabila la Yuda peke yake.
sw.R: Basi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwakasirikia Israeli sana, akawaondoa mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. Ni kabila la Yuda tu lililobaki.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} rất giận Y-sơ-ra-ên và dời họ khỏi trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; không còn sót lại ai, chỉ một mình chi tộc Giu-đa.
vi.B: Vì vậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} rất giận Y-sơ-ra-ên và dời họ khỏi trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Không còn sót lại ai ngoài một mình chi tộc Giu-đa.
vi.R: Vì vậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} rất giận Y-sơ-ra-ên, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đuổi họ đi khỏi trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Chỉ còn lại chi tộc Giu-đa.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘에게 몹시 노하셔서, 그들을 그분의 얼굴 앞에서 없애 버리셨다. 유다 지파만 홀로 남고, 아무도 남지 않았다.
ko.B: 그래서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 이스라엘에게 몹시 노하셔서 그들을 그분 앞에서 없애 버리셨다. 유다 지파만 남고 아무도 남지 않았다.
ko.R: 그래서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 이스라엘에게 몹시 노하셔서 그들을 그분 앞에서 쫓아 보내셨다. 유다 지파만 남았다.

pt.L: E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} se irou muito contra Israel, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os removeu de diante da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} face; não restou ninguém, senão somente a tribo de Judá.
pt.B: Por isso {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} ficou muito irado com Israel e os afastou da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} presença. Não restou ninguém, a não ser a tribo de Judá.
pt.R: Por isso {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} ficou muito irado com Israel e os mandou para longe da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} presença. Só a tribo de Judá ficou.

decisions.choice: removed them from before his face: sent them away from his presence
decisions.reason: To be before Yahweh's face is to live in his land, under his care, where he is worshiped. Exile takes them out of it (verse 23; 13:23).

decisions.choice: the tribe of Judah alone: the southern kingdom
decisions.reason: Judah stands for the whole kingdom of the south, which included Benjamin (1 Kings 12:21). The prophet Ahijah had spoken of Judah as the one tribe left to David's house (1 Kings 11:32, 36).

decisions.choice: his presence
decisions.reason: "Face" stands for presence, as often.

source.text: גַּם־יְהוּדָ֕ה לֹ֣א שָׁמַ֔ר אֶת־מִצְוֺ֖ת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֑ם וַיֵּ֣לְכ֔וּ בְּחֻקּ֥וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשֽׂוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Also Judah not kept [the] commandments of Yahweh their God, and they walked in [the] statutes of Israel which they made.

en.L: Judah also did not keep the commandments of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God, and they walked in the statutes of Israel that they made.
en.B: Even Judah failed to keep the commandments of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God. They walked in the statutes that Israel had made.
en.R: But even the people of Judah did not obey the commands of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God. They followed the laws that Israel had made.

es.L: También Judá no guardó los mandamientos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} su Dios, sino que anduvieron en los estatutos de Israel que ellos hicieron.
es.B: Tampoco Judá guardó los mandamientos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} su Dios. Anduvieron en los estatutos que Israel había hecho.
es.R: Pero ni siquiera la gente de Judá obedeció los mandatos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} su Dios. Siguieron las leyes que Israel había hecho.

fr.L: Juda non plus ne garda pas les commandements {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} leur Dieu, et ils marchèrent dans les prescriptions d’Israël, qu’ils avaient faites.
fr.B: Même Juda ne garda pas les commandements {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} son Dieu. Ses habitants suivirent les prescriptions qu’Israël avait instituées.
fr.R: Mais même le peuple de Juda n’a pas obéi aux commandements {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} son Dieu. Il a suivi les lois qu’Israël avait établies.

sw.L: Yuda nao hawakuzishika amri za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao, wakaenenda katika amri za Israeli walizozifanya.
sw.B: Hata Yuda hawakuzishika amri za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao. Walienenda katika amri ambazo Israeli walikuwa wameziweka.
sw.R: Lakini hata watu wa Yuda hawakuzitii amri za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao. Walifuata sheria ambazo Israeli walikuwa wameziweka.

vi.L: Giu-đa cũng không giữ các điều răn của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ, nhưng đi theo các luật lệ mà Y-sơ-ra-ên đã lập.
vi.B: Ngay cả Giu-đa cũng không giữ các điều răn của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ. Họ đi theo luật lệ mà Y-sơ-ra-ên đã lập.
vi.R: Nhưng ngay cả dân Giu-đa cũng không vâng giữ các mệnh lệnh của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ. Họ theo các luật lệ mà Y-sơ-ra-ên đã đặt ra.

ko.L: 유다도 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 계명들을 지키지 않고, 이스라엘이 만든 규례를 따라 걸었다.
ko.B: 그런데 유다도 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 계명을 지키지 않고, 이스라엘이 만든 규례를 따랐다.
ko.R: 그런데 유다 백성도 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 명령을 지키지 않았다. 그들은 이스라엘이 만든 법을 따랐다.

pt.L: Também Judá não guardou os mandamentos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o seu Deus, e andaram nos estatutos de Israel, que fizeram.
pt.B: Nem mesmo Judá guardou os mandamentos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o seu Deus. Andaram nos estatutos que Israel tinha feito.
pt.R: Mas nem mesmo o povo de Judá obedeceu aos mandamentos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o seu Deus. Eles seguiram as leis que Israel tinha feito.

decisions.choice: Judah too: a look ahead to Judah's fall
decisions.reason: The writer breaks off to say that Judah, the tribe left in verse 18, was no better. Judah would later be exiled for the same reasons (21:10-15; 23:26-27; 24:3-4).

decisions.choice: the statutes of Israel which they made: the practices Israel introduced
decisions.reason: As in verse 8, the statutes are the customs of worship Israel and its kings set up. "They" most naturally refers to Israel; it could also mean Judah adopting them.

decisions.choice: the people of Judah
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear that Judah is a people here, which fits the plural verb that follows.

source.text: וַיִּמְאַ֨ס יְהוָ֜ה בְּכָל־זֶ֤רַע יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וַיְעַנֵּ֔ם וַֽיִּתְּנֵ֖ם בְּיַד־שֹׁסִ֑ים עַ֛ד אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִשְׁלִיכָ֖ם מִפָּנָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And rejected Yahweh all [the] offspring of Israel, and afflicted them and gave them into [the] hand of plunderers, until that he cast them from his presence.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} rejected all the offspring of Israel, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} afflicted them and gave them into the hand of plunderers, until {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had cast them out from {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} presence.
en.B: So {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} rejected all Israel's descendants. He afflicted them and handed them over to plunderers, until {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had thrown them out of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} presence.
en.R: So {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} rejected all the descendants of Israel. He punished them and let raiders rob them, until at last {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} threw them out of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} presence.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} rechazó a toda la descendencia de Israel, y los afligió y los entregó en mano de saqueadores, hasta que los echó de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} presencia.
es.B: Así que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} rechazó a todos los descendientes de Israel. Los afligió y los entregó en manos de saqueadores, hasta que los arrojó de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} presencia.
es.R: Así que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} rechazó a todos los descendientes de Israel. Los castigó y dejó que los asaltantes les robaran, hasta que por fin los echó de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} presencia.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} rejeta toute la descendance d’Israël, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les humilia et les livra dans la main des pillards, jusqu’à ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les eût chassés de devant {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} face.
fr.B: Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} rejeta toute la descendance d’Israël. Il les humilia et les livra aux pillards, jusqu’à les chasser loin de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} présence.
fr.R: Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a rejeté tous les descendants d’Israël. Il les a punis et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a laissé des pillards les dépouiller, jusqu’au jour où {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a chassés loin de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.

sw.L: Naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akawakataa wazao wote wa Israeli, akawatesa, akawatia katika mkono wa wanyang'anyi, hata alipokwisha kuwatupa kutoka mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.B: Basi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwakataa wazao wote wa Israeli. Aliwatesa na kuwatia mikononi mwa wanyang'anyi, mpaka alipokuwa amewatupa kutoka mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.R: Basi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwakataa wazao wote wa Israeli. Aliwaadhibu na kuwaacha wavamizi wawanyang'anye, mpaka mwishowe akawatupa kutoka mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} khước từ cả dòng dõi Y-sơ-ra-ên, làm khổ họ và phó họ vào tay những kẻ cướp bóc, cho đến khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ném họ khỏi trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Vậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} khước từ toàn thể dòng dõi Y-sơ-ra-ên. Ngài làm khổ họ và phó họ cho những kẻ cướp bóc, cho đến khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ném họ khỏi trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Vậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} khước từ toàn thể con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên. Ngài trừng phạt họ và để quân cướp bóc họ, cho đến cuối cùng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ném họ ra khỏi trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘의 모든 자손을 버리시고, 그들을 괴롭게 하시고 그들을 약탈자들의 손에 넘기셔서, 마침내 그들을 그분의 앞에서 내던지셨다.
ko.B: 그래서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 이스라엘의 모든 자손을 버리셨다. 그분께서는 그들을 괴롭게 하시고 약탈자들의 손에 넘기셔서, 마침내 그들을 그분 앞에서 쫓아내셨다.
ko.R: 그래서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 이스라엘의 모든 자손을 버리셨다. 그분께서는 그들을 벌하시고 약탈자들에게 빼앗기게 하셨으며, 마침내 그들을 그분 앞에서 쫓아내셨다.

pt.L: E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} rejeitou toda a descendência de Israel, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os afligiu e os entregou na mão de saqueadores, até que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os lançou fora da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} presença.
pt.B: Assim {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} rejeitou todos os descendentes de Israel. Ele os afligiu e os entregou ao poder de saqueadores, até que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os expulsou da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} presença.
pt.R: Assim {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} rejeitou todos os descendentes de Israel. Ele os castigou e deixou que saqueadores os roubassem, até que por fim {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os expulsou da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} presença.

decisions.choice: Yahweh rejected: the answer to Israel's rejection
decisions.reason: The same verb was used of Israel rejecting Yahweh's statutes and covenant (verse 15). What they did to him he now does to them.

decisions.choice: all the offspring of Israel: the whole people
decisions.reason: After verse 19 the phrase may take in Judah too, whose rejection the writer foresees. In this passage it most likely means the northern kingdom, whose fall is being explained (verses 18, 21-23).

decisions.choice: gave them into the hand of plunderers: as in the days of the judges
decisions.reason: The same words describe Yahweh's discipline in Judges 2:14. Before the end came, Israel suffered raids and losses that should have turned them back (13:3, 7; 15:29).

decisions.choice: let raiders rob them
decisions.reason: Readable puts the picture of plunderers into a plain sentence.

decisions.choice: os entregou na mão de saqueadores (L); os entregou ao poder de saqueadores (B); deixou que saqueadores os roubassem (R)
decisions.reason: The words of Judges 2:14 (m3) are kept, level by level, as that verse has them in Portuguese, so that the reader hears the pattern of the judges' days.

source.text: כִּֽי־קָרַ֣ע יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל מֵעַל֙ בֵּ֣ית דָּוִ֔ד וַיַּמְלִ֖יכוּ אֶת־יָרָבְעָ֣ם בֶּן־נְבָ֑ט וַיַּדַּ֨ח יָרָבְעָ֤ם אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מֵאַחֲרֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וְהֶחֱטֵיאָ֖םחֲטָאָ֥ה גְדוֹלָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: For he tore Israel from upon [the] house of David, and they made king Jeroboam son of Nebat; and drove away Jeroboam Israel from after Yahweh, and made them sin a sin great.

en.L: For {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} tore Israel from the house of David, and they made Jeroboam son of Nebat king; and Jeroboam drove Israel away from following {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and made them sin a great sin.
en.B: When {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had torn Israel from David's house, they made Jeroboam son of Nebat king. Jeroboam drove Israel away from following {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and led them to commit a great sin.
en.R: When {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} tore Israel away from David's family, the people made Jeroboam son of Nebat their king. Jeroboam drew Israel away from following {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and led them into a great sin.

es.L: Porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} arrancó a Israel de la casa de David, y ellos hicieron rey a Jeroboam hijo de Nabat; y Jeroboam apartó a Israel de seguir {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y les hizo pecar un gran pecado.
es.B: Cuando {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} arrancó a Israel de la casa de David, ellos hicieron rey a Jeroboam hijo de Nabat. Jeroboam apartó a Israel de seguir {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y les hizo cometer un gran pecado.
es.R: Cuando {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} separó a Israel de la familia de David, el pueblo hizo rey a Jeroboam hijo de Nabat. Jeroboam alejó a Israel de seguir {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y lo hizo caer en un gran pecado.

fr.L: Car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} arracha Israël à la maison de David, et ils firent roi Jéroboam fils de Nebath ; et Jéroboam détourna Israël de suivre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et leur fit commettre un grand péché.
fr.B: Quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} eut arraché Israël à la maison de David, ils firent roi Jéroboam, fils de Nebath. Jéroboam détourna Israël de suivre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et lui fit commettre un grand péché.
fr.R: Quand {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a arraché Israël à la famille de David, le peuple a choisi Jéroboam fils de Nebath comme roi. Jéroboam a détourné Israël de {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et il lui a fait commettre un grand péché.

sw.L: Kwa maana aliwararua Israeli kutoka katika nyumba ya Daudi, nao wakamtawaza Yeroboamu mwana wa Nebati kuwa mfalme; naye Yeroboamu akawafukuza Israeli wasimfuate {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akawafanya watende dhambi kubwa.
sw.B: Alipokuwa amewararua Israeli kutoka katika nyumba ya Daudi, walimtawaza Yeroboamu mwana wa Nebati kuwa mfalme. Yeroboamu akawavuta Israeli mbali wasimfuate {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akawaongoza kutenda dhambi kubwa.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alipowatenga Israeli na ukoo wa Daudi, watu walimfanya Yeroboamu mwana wa Nebati kuwa mfalme wao. Yeroboamu aliwavuta Israeli mbali wasimfuate {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akawaongoza katika dhambi kubwa.

vi.L: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã xé Y-sơ-ra-ên khỏi nhà Đa-vít, và họ lập Giê-rô-bô-am con trai Nê-bát làm vua; Giê-rô-bô-am lôi kéo Y-sơ-ra-ên khỏi việc theo {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và khiến họ phạm một tội lớn.
vi.B: Khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã xé Y-sơ-ra-ên khỏi nhà Đa-vít, họ lập Giê-rô-bô-am con trai Nê-bát làm vua. Giê-rô-bô-am lôi kéo Y-sơ-ra-ên bỏ không theo {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nữa và khiến họ phạm một tội lớn.
vi.R: Khi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} xé Y-sơ-ra-ên khỏi dòng họ Đa-vít, dân chúng lập Giê-rô-bô-am con trai Nê-bát làm vua. Giê-rô-bô-am kéo Y-sơ-ra-ên ra khỏi đường theo {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và khiến họ phạm một tội lớn.

ko.L: 그분께서 이스라엘을 다윗의 집에서 찢어 내셨을 때, 그들이 느밧의 아들 여로보암을 왕으로 삼았다. 그리고 여로보암이 이스라엘을 몰아 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 따르지 않게 하고, 그들에게 큰 죄를 짓게 했다.
ko.B: 그분께서 이스라엘을 다윗 왕가에서 찢어 내셨을 때, 그들은 느밧의 아들 여로보암을 왕으로 삼았다. 여로보암은 이스라엘을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}에게서 떠나게 하고, 그들에게 큰 죄를 짓게 했다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘을 다윗 집안에서 떼어 내셨을 때, 백성은 느밧의 아들 여로보암을 왕으로 세웠다. 여로보암은 이스라엘이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 따르지 못하게 했고, 그들에게 큰 죄를 짓게 했다.

pt.L: Porque {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} arrancou Israel da casa de Davi, e fizeram rei Jeroboão, filho de Nebate; e Jeroboão afastou Israel de seguir {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} e os fez pecar um grande pecado.
pt.B: Quando {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} arrancou Israel da casa de Davi, eles fizeram rei Jeroboão, filho de Nebate. Jeroboão afastou Israel de seguir {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} e o levou a cometer um grande pecado.
pt.R: Quando {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} arrancou Israel da família de Davi, o povo fez de Jeroboão, filho de Nebate, o seu rei. Jeroboão afastou Israel {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e o levou a um grande pecado.

decisions.choice: he tore Israel from the house of David: Yahweh is the subject
alternatives: when Israel tore itself away from the house of David
decisions.reason: Yahweh, named in verse 20, tore the kingdom from David's house, as Ahijah said with the torn cloak (1 Kings 11:11, 31). The Hebrew can also be read with Israel as subject: "Israel tore itself away from the house of David" (compare 1 Kings 12:19).

decisions.choice: drove away: the reading of the Hebrew margin
decisions.reason: The written text and the Masoretes' marginal reading differ slightly in the form of this verb; both point to the verb meaning to drive away or lure away, used of leading people away from Yahweh in Deuteronomy 13:6, 11.

decisions.choice: made them sin a great sin: the sin of Jeroboam
decisions.reason: Jeroboam's calves at Bethel and Dan (1 Kings 12:28-30) are the sin by which he made Israel sin, the charge laid on nearly every king of Israel after him. "A great sin" is what Moses called the golden calf (Exodus 32:21, 30).

decisions.choice: made them sin (Literal); led them to commit (Balanced); led them into (Readable)
decisions.reason: The formula of the sin of Jeroboam has one wording at each level in Kings (1 Kings 16:2). Balanced adds "commit" because the object "a great sin" follows.

decisions.choice: the LORD (for "he")
decisions.reason: Readable names the subject, following m1.

decisions.choice: "les hizo pecar" (L); "les hizo cometer" (B); "lo hizo caer en" (R)
decisions.reason: The formula of the sin of Jeroboam keeps one wording at each level, as the terms note sets it; Readable names the LORD as the subject, as the English does (m1).

decisions.choice: aliwararua (no free pronoun, so no deity_pronoun span)
decisions.reason: The English has a deity pronoun span on "he"; Swahili marks the subject in the verb prefix, which takes no span. Readable names the LORD, as the English does.

decisions.choice: arrancou (every level); os fez pecar (L), o levou a cometer (B), o levou a (R) um grande pecado
decisions.reason: "Arrancar" is the verb 1 Kings 11:31 gives the tearing away of the kingdom in Portuguese (m1). The refrain of Jeroboam's sin keeps the wordings of 1 Kings 14:16 and 16:2 at each level; "um grande pecado" is what Moses calls the golden calf in Exodus 32:21 (m3).

source.text: וַיֵּֽלְכוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּכָל־חַטֹּ֥אות יָרָבְעָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה לֹא־סָ֖רוּ מִמֶּֽנָּה׃

records.literal_gloss: And walked [the] sons of Israel in all [the] sins of Jeroboam which he did; not they turned from it,

en.L: And the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel walked in all the sins of Jeroboam that he did; they did not turn aside from them,
en.B: The {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} walked in all the sins that Jeroboam committed and did not turn away from them,
en.R: The {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} kept on committing all the sins that Jeroboam had committed. They never turned away from them.

es.L: Y los hijos de Israel anduvieron en todos los pecados que Jeroboam hizo; no se apartaron de ello,
es.B: Los israelitas anduvieron en todos los pecados que cometió Jeroboam y no se apartaron de ellos,
es.R: Los israelitas siguieron cometiendo todos los pecados que Jeroboam había cometido. Nunca se apartaron de ellos.

fr.L: Et les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël marchèrent dans tous les péchés que Jéroboam avait commis ; ils ne s’en détournèrent pas,
fr.B: Les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} marchèrent dans tous les péchés que Jéroboam avait commis et ne s’en détournèrent pas,
fr.R: Les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} ont continué à commettre tous les péchés que Jéroboam avait commis. Ils ne s’en sont jamais détournés.

sw.L: Nao wana wa Israeli wakaenenda katika dhambi zote za Yeroboamu alizozifanya; hawakuziacha,
sw.B: Waisraeli walienenda katika dhambi zote alizozifanya Yeroboamu, wala hawakuziacha,
sw.R: Waisraeli waliendelea kutenda dhambi zote alizozitenda Yeroboamu. Hawakuziacha kamwe.

vi.L: Con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên đi trong mọi tội Giê-rô-bô-am đã phạm; họ không lìa bỏ tội ấy,
vi.B: Con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên đi trong mọi tội Giê-rô-bô-am đã phạm và không từ bỏ các tội ấy,
vi.R: Dân Y-sơ-ra-ên cứ phạm mọi tội mà Giê-rô-bô-am đã phạm. Họ không bao giờ từ bỏ các tội ấy.

ko.L: 그리고 이스라엘 자손은 여로보암이 행한 모든 죄를 따라 걸었고, 그것에서 떠나지 않았다.
ko.B: 이스라엘 자손은 여로보암이 지은 모든 죄를 따라 살았고, 그 죄에서 떠나지 않았다.
ko.R: 이스라엘 사람들은 여로보암이 지은 모든 죄를 계속 지었다. 그들은 그 죄에서 결코 떠나지 않았다.

pt.L: E os filhos de Israel andaram em todos os pecados que Jeroboão cometeu; não se desviaram deles,
pt.B: Os israelitas andaram em todos os pecados que Jeroboão cometeu e não se afastaram deles,
pt.R: Os israelitas continuaram cometendo todos os pecados que Jeroboão tinha cometido. Nunca deixaram esses pecados.

decisions.choice: from it: from the sin of Jeroboam
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "from it", treating Jeroboam's sins as one: the worship he set up. The sentence runs on into verse 23.

decisions.choice: walked in all the sins of Jeroboam: the whole history of the northern kingdom
decisions.reason: What was said of each king (1 Kings 15:26, 34; 16:26) is now said of the people as a whole: from Jeroboam to the end, they never left his way of worship.

decisions.choice: kept on committing
decisions.reason: Readable puts "walked in" as ongoing action, and ends the sentence here; verse 23 begins a new one.

source.text: עַ֠ד אֲשֶׁר־הֵסִ֨יר יְהוָ֤ה אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מֵעַ֣ל פָּנָ֔יו כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֔ר בְּיַ֖ד כָּל־עֲבָדָ֣יו הַנְּבִיאִ֑ים וַיִּ֨גֶל יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל מֵעַ֤ל אַדְמָתוֹ֙ אַשּׁ֔וּרָה עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: until that removed Yahweh Israel from before his face, as he had spoken by [the] hand of all his servants the prophets; and went into exile Israel from upon its land to Assyria until the day the this.

en.L: until {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} removed Israel from before {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} face, as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had spoken by the hand of all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} slaves the prophets. And Israel went into exile from its land to Assyria, to this day.
en.B: until {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} removed Israel from {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} presence, as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had said through all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servants the prophets. So Israel went into exile from its own land to Assyria, to this day.
en.R: This went on until {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} sent Israel away from {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} presence, just as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had warned through all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servants the prophets. So the people of Israel were taken away from their own land as captives to Assyria, and they are still there to this day.

es.L: hasta que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} quitó a Israel de delante de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} rostro, como lo había dicho por mano de todos {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} siervos los profetas. E Israel fue llevado cautivo de su tierra a Asiria, hasta el día de hoy.
es.B: hasta que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} quitó a Israel de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} presencia, como lo había dicho por medio de todos {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} siervos los profetas. Así Israel fue llevado cautivo de su propia tierra a Asiria, hasta el día de hoy.
es.R: Así siguieron hasta que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} echó a Israel de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} presencia, tal como lo había advertido por medio de todos {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} siervos los profetas. Por eso el pueblo de Israel fue llevado de su propia tierra a Asiria como prisionero, y todavía sigue allí hasta el día de hoy.

fr.L: jusqu’à ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ôte Israël de devant {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} face, comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’avait dit par la main de tous {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} esclaves les prophètes. Et Israël fut déporté de sur sa terre en Assyrie, jusqu’à ce jour.
fr.B: jusqu’à ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} rejette Israël loin de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} présence, comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’avait annoncé par tous {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} serviteurs les prophètes. Ainsi Israël fut emmené en exil loin de sa terre, en Assyrie, jusqu’à aujourd’hui.
fr.R: Cela a duré jusqu’au jour où {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a renvoyé Israël loin de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’avait annoncé par tous {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} serviteurs les prophètes. Ainsi, le peuple d’Israël a été emmené de son pays en Assyrie comme prisonnier, et il y est encore aujourd’hui.

sw.L: hata {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alipowaondoa Israeli mbele ya uso {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, kama alivyokuwa amenena kwa mkono wa watumwa {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wote manabii. Nao Israeli wakahamishwa kutoka katika nchi yao mpaka Ashuru, mpaka siku hii ya leo.
sw.B: mpaka {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alipowaondoa Israeli mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, kama alivyokuwa amesema kupitia watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wote manabii. Basi Israeli walichukuliwa uhamishoni kutoka katika nchi yao wenyewe mpaka Ashuru, nao wako huko mpaka leo.
sw.R: Jambo hilo liliendelea mpaka {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alipowaondoa Israeli mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, kama alivyokuwa ameonya kupitia watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wote manabii. Basi watu wa Israeli walichukuliwa mateka kutoka katika nchi yao wenyewe mpaka Ashuru, nao bado wako huko mpaka leo.

vi.L: cho đến khi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} dời Y-sơ-ra-ên khỏi trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán bởi tay mọi đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là các nhà tiên tri. Y-sơ-ra-ên bị lưu đày khỏi đất mình sang A-si-ri cho đến ngày nay.
vi.B: cho đến khi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} dời Y-sơ-ra-ên khỏi trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán qua mọi đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là các nhà tiên tri. Vậy Y-sơ-ra-ên bị lưu đày khỏi đất mình sang A-si-ri cho đến ngày nay.
vi.R: Việc ấy cứ tiếp diễn cho đến khi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đuổi Y-sơ-ra-ên đi khỏi trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, đúng như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã cảnh cáo qua mọi đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là các nhà tiên tri. Vậy dân Y-sơ-ra-ên bị bắt đem khỏi đất mình sang A-si-ri làm tù binh, và họ vẫn còn ở đó cho đến ngày nay.

ko.L: 마침내 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 모든 종 예언자들의 손으로 말씀하신 대로 이스라엘을 그분의 얼굴 앞에서 없애 버리셨다. 그래서 이스라엘이 자기 땅에서 앗시리아로 사로잡혀 가서 오늘날까지 [있다].
ko.B: 마침내 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 그분의 모든 종 예언자들을 통하여 말씀하신 대로 이스라엘을 그분 앞에서 없애 버리셨다. 그래서 이스라엘은 자기 땅에서 앗시리아로 사로잡혀 가서 오늘날까지 거기에 있다.
ko.R: 이런 일은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘을 그분 앞에서 쫓아 보내실 때까지 계속되었다. 그분께서 그분의 모든 종 예언자들을 통하여 경고하신 그대로였다. 그래서 이스라엘 백성은 자기 땅에서 포로로 잡혀 앗시리아로 끌려갔고, 오늘날까지 그곳에 있다.

pt.L: até que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} removeu Israel de diante da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} face, como {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} tinha falado pela mão de todos os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} escravos, os profetas. E Israel foi levado para o exílio, da sua terra para a Assíria, até este dia.
pt.B: até que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} afastou Israel da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} presença, como {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} tinha dito por meio de todos os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} servos, os profetas. Assim Israel foi levado da sua própria terra para o exílio na Assíria, onde está até hoje.
pt.R: Isso continuou até que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} mandou Israel para longe da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} presença, exatamente como {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} tinha avisado por meio de todos os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} servos, os profetas. Assim o povo de Israel foi tirado da sua própria terra e levado como prisioneiro para a Assíria, e está lá até hoje.

decisions.choice: as he had spoken through his servants the prophets
decisions.reason: Ahijah had foretold that Yahweh would uproot Israel and scatter it beyond the River for Jeroboam's sins (1 Kings 14:15-16), and Amos and Hosea warned of exile (Amos 5:27; 7:17; Hosea 9:3). Kings shows the prophets' word coming true.

decisions.choice: to this day: the writer's own day
decisions.reason: As in 2:22, "to this day" means the time when the account was written. The exiles of the northern kingdom had not returned.

decisions.choice: went into exile: was carried away from its land
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used of the deportation in verse 6. Verses 7-23 end where they began.

decisions.choice: slaves (Literal); servants (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As in verse 13.

decisions.choice: This went on until ...; they are still there
decisions.reason: Readable starts a new sentence, since verse 22 ended its own, and spells out what "to this day" means here.

decisions.choice: A new sentence opening with "마침내" (L, B) after verse 22 closes
alternatives: one sentence across the verse marker
decisions.reason: The Hebrew runs verse 22 into verse 23 ("until"); Korean cannot leave the main verb in verse 22 hanging, so verse 22 ends a sentence and "마침내" carries the "until".

source.text: וַיָּבֵ֣א מֶֽלֶךְ־אַשּׁ֡וּר מִבָּבֶ֡ל וּ֠מִכּוּ֠תָה וּמֵעַוָּ֤א וּמֵֽחֲמָת֙ וּסְפַרְוַ֔יִם וַיֹּ֨שֶׁב֙ בְּעָרֵ֣י שֹֽׁמְר֔וֹן תַּ֖חַת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּֽרְשׁוּ֙ אֶת־שֹׁ֣מְר֔וֹן וַיֵּֽשְׁב֖וּ בְּעָרֶֽיהָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And brought [the] king of Assyria from Babylon and from Cuthah and from Avva and from Hamath and Sepharvaim, and settled [them] in [the] cities of Samaria in place of [the] sons of Israel; and they took possession of Samaria and lived in its cities.

en.L: And the king of Assyria brought [people] from Babylon and from Cuthah and from Avva and from Hamath and Sepharvaim, and he settled [them] in the cities of Samaria in place of the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel. And they took possession of Samaria and lived in its cities.
en.B: From Babylon, Cuthah, Avva, Hamath and Sepharvaim the king of Assyria brought people and settled them in the cities of Samaria in place of the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}. They took possession of Samaria and lived in its cities.
en.R: The king of Assyria brought in people from Babylon, Cuthah, Avva, Hamath and Sepharvaim. He made them live in the towns of Samaria in place of the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}. They took over Samaria and lived in its towns.

es.L: Y el rey de Asiria trajo [gente] de Babilonia, y de Cuta, y de Ava, y de Hamat y de Sefarvaim, y [los] estableció en las ciudades de Samaria en lugar de los hijos de Israel. Y ellos poseyeron Samaria y habitaron en sus ciudades.
es.B: El rey de Asiria trajo gente de Babilonia, Cuta, Ava, Hamat y Sefarvaim, y la estableció en las ciudades de Samaria en lugar de los israelitas. Ellos tomaron posesión de Samaria y vivieron en sus ciudades.
es.R: El rey de Asiria trajo gente de Babilonia, Cuta, Ava, Hamat y Sefarvaim. Los hizo vivir en las ciudades de Samaria en lugar de los israelitas. Se adueñaron de Samaria y vivieron en sus ciudades.

fr.L: Et le roi d’Assyrie fit venir [des gens] de Babylone, de Kouta, d’Avva, de Hamath et de Sepharvaïm, et il [les] établit dans les villes de Samarie à la place des {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël. Et ils prirent possession de Samarie et habitèrent dans ses villes.
fr.B: Le roi d’Assyrie fit venir des gens de Babylone, de Kouta, d’Avva, de Hamath et de Sepharvaïm, et les établit dans les villes de Samarie à la place des {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}. Ils prirent possession de la Samarie et habitèrent dans ses villes.
fr.R: Le roi d’Assyrie a fait venir des gens de Babylone, de Kouta, d’Avva, de Hamath et de Sepharvaïm. Il les a installés dans les villes de Samarie à la place des {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}. Ils se sont emparés de la Samarie et ils ont habité dans ses villes.

sw.L: Naye mfalme wa Ashuru akaleta [watu] kutoka Babeli na kutoka Kutha na kutoka Ava na kutoka Hamathi na Sefarvaimu, akawakalisha katika miji ya Samaria mahali pa wana wa Israeli. Nao wakaimiliki Samaria, wakakaa katika miji yake.
sw.B: Mfalme wa Ashuru alileta watu kutoka Babeli, Kutha, Ava, Hamathi na Sefarvaimu, akawaweka katika miji ya Samaria mahali pa Waisraeli. Nao wakaimiliki Samaria, wakaishi katika miji yake.
sw.R: Mfalme wa Ashuru alileta watu kutoka Babeli, Kutha, Ava, Hamathi na Sefarvaimu. Akawafanya waishi katika miji ya Samaria mahali pa Waisraeli. Wakaitwaa Samaria, wakaishi katika miji yake.

vi.L: Vua A-si-ri đưa [người] từ Ba-by-lôn, từ Cu-tha, từ A-va, từ Ha-mát và Sê-phạt-va-im đến, cho [họ] định cư trong các thành của Sa-ma-ri thay cho con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên. Họ chiếm lấy Sa-ma-ri và sống trong các thành của nó.
vi.B: Vua A-si-ri đưa người từ Ba-by-lôn, Cu-tha, A-va, Ha-mát và Sê-phạt-va-im đến, cho họ định cư trong các thành của Sa-ma-ri thay cho dân Y-sơ-ra-ên. Họ chiếm lấy Sa-ma-ri và sống trong các thành của xứ ấy.
vi.R: Vua A-si-ri đưa người từ Ba-by-lôn, Cu-tha, A-va, Ha-mát và Sê-phạt-va-im đến. Vua cho họ sống trong các thành của Sa-ma-ri thay cho dân Y-sơ-ra-ên. Họ chiếm lấy Sa-ma-ri và sống trong các thành ở đó.

ko.L: 그리고 앗시리아 왕이 바빌론과 구다와 아와와 하맛과 스발와임에서 [사람들을] 데려와서, 이스라엘 자손 대신 사마리아의 성읍들에 살게 했다. 그리고 그들이 사마리아를 차지하고 그 성읍들에서 살았다.
ko.B: 앗시리아 왕은 바빌론과 구다와 아와와 하맛과 스발와임에서 사람들을 데려와서, 이스라엘 자손 대신 사마리아의 성읍들에 살게 했다. 그들은 사마리아를 차지하고 그 성읍들에서 살았다.
ko.R: 앗시리아 왕은 바빌론, 구다, 아와, 하맛, 스발와임에서 사람들을 데려왔다. 그는 그들을 이스라엘 사람들 대신 사마리아의 성읍들에서 살게 했다. 그들은 사마리아를 차지하고 그 성읍들에서 살았다.

pt.L: E o rei da Assíria trouxe [gente] da Babilônia, e de Cuta, e de Ava, e de Hamate, e de Sefarvaim, e [os] fez habitar nas cidades de Samaria em lugar dos filhos de Israel. E tomaram posse de Samaria e habitaram nas suas cidades.
pt.B: O rei da Assíria trouxe gente da Babilônia, de Cuta, de Ava, de Hamate e de Sefarvaim e a estabeleceu nas cidades de Samaria em lugar dos israelitas. Eles tomaram posse de Samaria e moraram nas suas cidades.
pt.R: O rei da Assíria trouxe gente da Babilônia, de Cuta, de Ava, de Hamate e de Sefarvaim. Ele fez essa gente morar nas cidades de Samaria no lugar dos israelitas. Eles se apossaram de Samaria e moraram nas suas cidades.

decisions.choice: brought ... and settled them: Assyria's exchange of peoples
decisions.reason: Assyria moved conquered peoples away and brought others from far parts of the empire in their place, so that no people could easily rebel in its own land. Sargon II records settling foreigners in Samaria, and later kings sent more (Ezra 4:2, 10).

decisions.choice: Babylon, Cuthah, Avva, Hamath, Sepharvaim
decisions.reason: Babylon and Cuthah were cities of southern Mesopotamia, which Assyria then ruled. Hamath was a city of Syria on the Orontes river. Avva and Sepharvaim are not certainly located; they are named with Hamath again in 18:34 and 19:13, and were probably in Syria.

decisions.choice: Samaria: now the name of the region
decisions.reason: "The cities of Samaria" are the towns of the land around the capital. From here on Samaria names the whole province, not only the city.

decisions.choice: took possession of Samaria
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used of Israel taking possession of Canaan (Deuteronomy 1:8). Now others take possession of Israel's land, as the nations once lost it to Israel (verses 8, 11).

decisions.choice: took over
decisions.reason: Readable puts "took possession of" in plain words.

decisions.choice: "Babilonia", "Cuta", "Ava", "Hamat", "Sefarvaim"
decisions.reason: The usual Spanish forms, with "Babilonia" and "Hamat" as the terms note's table gives them.

decisions.choice: "la Samarie" (B, R) for the region
decisions.reason: Samaria now names the whole region (m3); French marks the region with the article, "la Samarie", and keeps the city as "Samarie". Literal keeps the bare name.

decisions.choice: a Babilônia, Cuta, Ava, Hamate, Sefarvaim
decisions.reason: For the whole book (also 18:34; 19:13): the cities (m2) take Brazilian forms, "Babilônia" with its article, "Hamate" as 1 Kings 8:65 writes it, with the final "-e" Portuguese adds after a consonant, and "Cuta", "Ava" and "Sefarvaim" as they stand.
